instruction: 选择把两个短句合并得最正确的一项。
content: Many elderly people live in remote villages. These villages have no hospitals.
options: Many elderly people live in remote villages, these villages have no hospitals.
Many elderly people live in remote villages that have no hospitals.
Many elderly people live in remote villages, which they have no hospitals.
Many elderly people live in remote villages where have no hospitals.
option_explanations: 错误：两个完整句子只用逗号连接，构成逗号粘连（comma splice）。
正确：that 引导限制性定语从句修饰 villages，并在从句中作主语，两条信息合并得自然。
错误：which 后面又跟了完整句子 they have no hospitals，关系代词在从句中没有成分可充当，属于汉语式的“重复主语”。
错误：where 是关系副词，从句仍需要自己的主语，应写成 where there are no hospitals。
hints: 看第二句中的 These villages 指的是第一句里的哪个词。
用定语从句合并时，关系代词本身就在从句中充当成分，不能再重复主语。
检查每个选项：连接处是否只有一个连接手段，从句是否既有主语又有谓语。
explanation: 两个句子共享名词 villages，可用定语从句合并：关系代词 that / which 代替第二句的 These villages，并在从句中作主语。正确句：Many elderly people live in remote villages that have no hospitals. 不能只用逗号连接两个完整句，也不能在关系代词后再加 they；where 作关系副词时，从句还需要自己的主语。

instruction: 两个句子之间是转折关系。选择合并正确的一项。
content: Online courses are cheap. Many learners fail to complete them.
options: Although online courses are cheap, but many learners fail to complete them.
Online courses are cheap, many learners fail to complete them.
Because online courses are cheap, many learners fail to complete them.
Although online courses are cheap, many learners fail to complete them.
option_explanations: 错误：although 和 but 不能同时使用，这是汉语“虽然……但是……”的迁移，二者只能选一个。
错误：逗号粘连，两个独立分句之间缺少连词。
错误：语法正确但逻辑不符——题目说明两句之间是转折关系，而 because 表示因果。
正确：although 引导让步状语从句，主句前不再加 but，逻辑和语法都正确。
hints: 先确定两句的逻辑关系，再看连接处用了几个连词。
although 和 but 都表示转折/让步，同一个连接点只能用其中一个。
先排除逻辑关系不对的选项，再排除“双连词”和“只有逗号”的选项。
explanation: 表达让步/转折时，可以用 Although A, B 或 A, but B，二者择一。汉语说“虽然……但是……”，英语却不能写 although…but。正确句：Although online courses are cheap, many learners fail to complete them.

instruction: 选择合并得语法正确、逻辑清楚的一项。
content: The government raised taxes on cigarettes. It hoped to reduce smoking.
options: Hoping to reduce smoking, the government raised taxes on cigarettes.
Hoping to reduce smoking, taxes on cigarettes were raised by the government.
The government raised taxes on cigarettes, it hoped to reduce smoking.
The government raised taxes on cigarettes, which hoped to reduce smoking.
option_explanations: 正确：分词短语 Hoping to reduce smoking 的逻辑主语是 the government，与主句主语一致，表达动机。
错误：悬垂分词。主句主语变成了 taxes，句子意思变成“税希望减少吸烟”，逻辑不通。
错误：逗号粘连，两个完整句子只用逗号相连。
错误：which 指代前面的 cigarettes（或整个分句），它们不能“希望”；希望的是政府。
hints: 找出每个选项中“希望减少吸烟”这个动作的执行者是谁。
句首分词短语的逻辑主语必须是紧跟其后的主句主语。
在每个选项里，看分词短语或从句所指的名词能不能 hope。
explanation: 用分词短语合并时，分词的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致，否则就是悬垂分词（dangling participle）。“希望减少吸烟”的是政府，所以主句主语必须是 the government：Hoping to reduce smoking, the government raised taxes on cigarettes. 改成被动后主语变成 taxes，就成了“税在希望”。

instruction: 用同位语合并两个句子。选择正确的一项。
content: Singapore is a small city-state. It has one of the best public transport systems in the world.
options: Singapore is a small city-state, has one of the best public transport systems in the world.
Singapore, which a small city-state, has one of the best public transport systems in the world.
Singapore, a small city-state, has one of the best public transport systems in the world.
Singapore, it is a small city-state, has one of the best public transport systems in the world.
option_explanations: 错误：第二个谓语 has 前既没有主语也没有连词，句子结构断裂。
错误：which 引导的定语从句缺少谓语动词，应为 which is a small city-state。
正确：a small city-state 作 Singapore 的同位语，用两个逗号隔开，简洁地补充说明。
错误：在主语和谓语之间插入完整句子 it is a small city-state，出现两个主语，语法错误。
hints: 第一句其实只是在解释 Singapore 是什么。
名词短语可以直接放在另一个名词后面作同位语，用逗号隔开，不需要动词。
检查每个选项夹在两个逗号之间的部分：它是名词短语、完整句子，还是缺了动词的从句？
explanation: 当一个句子只是用“A is B”解释某个名词时，可以把 B 变成同位语：去掉 is，把名词短语放在 A 后面并用逗号隔开。正确句：Singapore, a small city-state, has one of the best public transport systems in the world. 若用定语从句，必须写全 which is a small city-state。

instruction: 把三个句子合并成一句。选择逻辑关系和语法都正确的一项。
content: Remote work saves commuting time. Some employees feel isolated. They miss face-to-face contact with colleagues.
options: Because remote work saves commuting time, some employees feel isolated, they miss face-to-face contact with colleagues.
Although remote work saves commuting time, some employees feel isolated because they miss face-to-face contact with colleagues.
Remote work saves commuting time, although some employees feel isolated, which miss face-to-face contact with colleagues.
Although remote work saves commuting time, but some employees feel isolated, missing face-to-face contact with colleagues.
option_explanations: 错误：“节省通勤时间”不是“感到孤立”的原因，逻辑关系用错；后半句还有逗号粘连。
正确：although 表达第一、二句之间的让步关系，because 说明感到孤立的原因，信息完整、语法正确。
错误：which 不能指人，这里指 employees 应该用 who，而且 which 紧跟在 isolated 后面，指代不清。
错误：although 与 but 重复使用。
hints: 分别判断：第1句和第2句是什么关系？第2句和第3句又是什么关系？
每一处逻辑关系只用一个连接词；指人的定语从句用 who 而不是 which。
排除双连词、逗号粘连和关系代词指代错误的选项。
explanation: 三句话包含两种关系：远程办公节省时间 vs. 员工感到孤立（让步/转折）；员工感到孤立 ← 想念面对面交流（原因）。分别用 although 和 because 表达：Although remote work saves commuting time, some employees feel isolated because they miss face-to-face contact with colleagues. 注意不能 although…but 连用，指人用 who 而不是 which。

instruction: 把下面三个短句合并成一个句子，可使用定语从句、同位语或分词短语，保留所有信息。
content:
Air pollution is a serious problem in many large cities.
It causes respiratory diseases.
These diseases particularly affect children and the elderly.
accepted: Air pollution, a serious problem in many large cities, causes respiratory diseases that particularly affect children and the elderly.
Air pollution, which is a serious problem in many large cities, causes respiratory diseases that particularly affect children and the elderly.
In many large cities, air pollution is a serious problem, causing respiratory diseases that particularly affect children and the elderly.
criteria: 1）只能是一个句子；2）必须保留三条信息：空气污染是许多大城市的严重问题、它导致呼吸道疾病、这些疾病尤其影响儿童和老人；3）第三句须用定语从句（that / which）等方式与 diseases 连接，第一句可用同位语、非限制性定语从句或主句表达；4）不得出现逗号粘连、悬垂分词或重复主语（如 which it）；5）语法正确、自然。其他正确的合并方式同样接受。
hints: 注意第2句的 It 和第3句的 These diseases 分别指代前一句中的哪个名词。
指代前面名词的句子可以变成定语从句；只是解释“某物是什么”的句子可以变成同位语。
试着以 Air pollution 作主语、causes 作主句谓语，把其余两句“挂”在相应的名词后面。
explanation: 合并时先找主干：Air pollution causes respiratory diseases。第1句只是说明空气污染是什么，可变为同位语（, a serious problem in many large cities,）或非限制性定语从句；第3句修饰 diseases，可变为限制性定语从句（that particularly affect…）。示例：Air pollution, a serious problem in many large cities, causes respiratory diseases that particularly affect children and the elderly.

instruction: 把下面三个短句合并成一个句子，需同时体现原因/目的关系和转折关系，保留所有信息。
content:
Many young people move to big cities.
They want better job opportunities.
They often struggle with high housing costs.
accepted: Many young people move to big cities in search of better job opportunities, but they often struggle with high housing costs.
Although many young people move to big cities for better job opportunities, they often struggle with high housing costs there.
Many young people move to big cities because they want better job opportunities; however, they often struggle with high housing costs.
criteria: 1）合并为一个句子（允许使用一个分号）；2）必须表达“想要更好的工作机会”是年轻人搬到大城市的原因或目的（because / to find / for / in search of / hoping for 等）；3）必须表达“高房价困扰”与前文之间的转折或让步关系（but / although / yet / however 等）；4）保留全部信息；5）不得出现 although…but、because…so 连用、逗号粘连或悬垂分词；6）语法正确。其他正确写法同样接受。
hints: 三句的主语都是同一群人，想一想哪两句之间是“为什么”，哪两句之间是“但是”。
原因/目的可用 because、to do、for、in search of；转折可用 but 或 although，二者不能用在同一个连接点。
先写“搬到大城市 + 目的”，再用一个转折连接词引出住房问题。
explanation: 第1、2句是“行为 + 目的/原因”，可用 in search of / to find / because 等连接；第3句与前面形成转折：本来为机会而来，却被高房价困扰。示例：Many young people move to big cities in search of better job opportunities, but they often struggle with high housing costs. 注意 although 和 but 只用一个。

instruction: 把下面四个短句合并成一个句子（最多可用一个分号），清楚体现因果关系、转折关系以及专家担忧的具体内容。
content:
Artificial intelligence can mark essays instantly.
This gives teachers more time for individual feedback.
Some experts are concerned.
Students may begin to write for the software rather than for human readers.
accepted: Artificial intelligence can mark essays instantly, which gives teachers more time for individual feedback; however, some experts are concerned that students may begin to write for the software rather than for human readers.

Although artificial intelligence can mark essays instantly and thus give teachers more time for individual feedback, some experts are concerned that students may begin to write for the software rather than for human readers.

Because artificial intelligence can mark essays instantly, teachers have more time for individual feedback, but some experts are concerned that students may begin to write for the software rather than for human readers.
criteria: 1）合并为一个句子（允许使用一个分号）；2）必须体现：AI 即时批改 → 教师有更多时间做个性化反馈（因果/结果关系，可用 which、because、so、thus 等）；3）必须体现前面的好处与专家担忧之间的转折/让步（however、but、although 等）；4）第4句必须作为专家担忧的内容，用 concerned that… / worried that… 等从句连接，不能另起一句；5）保留全部信息；6）无逗号粘连、although…but 连用、which 指代不清等错误；语法正确。其他正确写法同样接受。
hints: 第2句的 This 指第1句整件事；第4句其实是在说明第3句的专家“担心什么”。
指代前面整个分句可用非限制性 which；“担心的内容”可以用 be concerned that + 从句。
整个句子可分为两半：前半句讲好处（因果），后半句用一个转折词引出担忧。
explanation: 四句包含三层关系：①AI 即时批改 → 教师有更多反馈时间（结果，可用 , which gives…）；②好处与担忧之间的转折（however / but / although）；③第4句是担忧的内容，用 that 从句作 concerned 的补足成分。示例：Artificial intelligence can mark essays instantly, which gives teachers more time for individual feedback; however, some experts are concerned that students may begin to write for the software rather than for human readers.

instruction: 选择能使句子保持平行结构的选项填空。
content: Regular exercise can improve sleep, reduce stress and ______.
options: boosting energy levels
to boost energy levels
an energy boost
boost energy levels
option_explanations: 错误：boosting 是 -ing 形式，与前面的动词原形 improve、reduce 不一致。
错误：情态动词 can 后面应接动词原形，to boost 与 improve、reduce 不平行。
错误：名词短语与前两个动词短语形式不同，破坏平行。
正确：boost energy levels 与 improve sleep、reduce stress 都是“动词原形 + 名词”，都接在 can 后面。
hints: 看空格前面的两个并列项是什么形式。
and 连接的三项要用相同的语法形式，并且都能接在 can 后面。
把每个选项单独放在 can 后面读一读。
explanation: and 连接的并列成分必须形式一致。前两项 improve sleep、reduce stress 都是接在 can 后面的动词原形短语，第三项也要用动词原形：Regular exercise can improve sleep, reduce stress and boost energy levels.

instruction: 选择能使句子保持平行结构的选项填空。
content: Many parents believe that children should learn to play an instrument, to speak a foreign language and ______.
options: swimming
to swim
they can swim
the skill of swimming
option_explanations: 错误：swimming 是动名词，与前面两个 to do 不平行。
正确：to swim 与 to play、to speak 形式相同，三项都作 learn 的宾语。
错误：they can swim 是完整分句，不能与两个不定式并列。
错误：名词短语与前面两个不定式形式不一致，而且表达啰嗦。
hints: 注意前两个并列项开头的词。
并列项如果每一项都写了 to，最后一项也要保持同样的形式。
试着把每个选项接在 learn 后面读，看它是否与 to play、to speak 同形。
explanation: learn 后面的三个并列宾语都应是不定式：learn to play an instrument, to speak a foreign language and to swim. 前面每一项都写了 to，最后一项也要写 to，形式才统一。

instruction: 四个句子都想表达“新政策旨在减少排放、创造绿色就业并保护公众健康”。选择平行结构正确的一句。
options: The new policy aims to cut emissions, creating green jobs and the protection of public health.
The new policy aims to cut emissions, to create green jobs and protecting public health.
The new policy aims to cut emissions, create green jobs and protect public health.
The new policy aims at cutting emissions, create green jobs and to protect public health.
option_explanations: 错误：三项分别是不定式、-ing 短语和名词短语，形式混杂。
错误：前两项是不定式，第三项却变成 protecting，不平行。
正确：三项都是动词原形短语，共用前面的 to：to cut…, create… and protect…。
错误：cutting、create、to protect 三种形式混用；aims at 后也不能接动词原形或不定式。
hints: 找出每个句子中并列的三个目标。
三个目标要么都用 to do（或共用一个 to），要么都用 doing。
检查每个选项的三项能否都接在同一个开头（aims to / aims at）后面。
explanation: aims to 后面的三个目标必须形式一致。可以共用一个 to：aims to cut emissions, create green jobs and protect public health；也可以每项都写 to。混用 to do、doing 和名词就破坏了平行结构。

instruction: 句中有一处平行结构错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Online learning is not only flexible but also saves money.
accepted: Online learning is not only flexible but also economical.
Online learning is not only flexible but also cost-effective.
Online learning is not only flexible but also inexpensive.
Online learning is not only flexible but also affordable.
Online learning is not only flexible but also cheap.
Online learning is not only flexible but also low-cost.
Online learning not only is flexible but also saves money.
Online learning not only offers flexibility but also saves money.
Not only is online learning flexible, but it also saves money.
criteria: 必须使 not only 和 but also 后面的成分语法形式一致：要么两边都是形容词（flexible / economical、cost-effective、cheap 等），要么两边都是动词短语（not only is flexible / offers flexibility … but also saves money），或使用倒装 Not only is…, but it also…。须保持原意（灵活 + 省钱）。其他语法正确的平行改法也接受。
hints: 看 not only 和 but also 后面分别紧跟什么成分。
关联连词 not only…but also 两边的成分必须词性/结构相同。
一边是形容词，另一边是动词短语——想办法让它们变成同一类。
explanation: not only…but also 连接的两个成分必须对称。原句 not only 后接形容词 flexible，but also 后接动词短语 saves money，不平行。可改为两个形容词：is not only flexible but also economical；或两个动词短语：not only is flexible but also saves money。

instruction: 句中有一处比较结构不平行的错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Many people think that cycling to work is healthier than to drive.
accepted: Many people think that cycling to work is healthier than driving.
Many people think that cycling to work is healthier than driving to work.
Many people think that cycling to work is healthier than driving there.
Many people think cycling to work is healthier than driving.
Many people think cycling to work is healthier than driving to work.
Many people think that to cycle to work is healthier than to drive.
Many people think that to cycle to work is healthier than to drive to work.
criteria: 比较结构 than 两侧被比较的成分必须语法形式一致：cycling…than driving（推荐），或 to cycle…than to drive。须保持原意；其他语法正确的平行改法也接受。
hints: 找出 than 两边被比较的两样东西。
比较结构两侧的成分形式要一致：动名词对动名词，不定式对不定式。
that 从句的主语是一个 -ing 形式，than 后面的形式要和它一样。
explanation: 比较结构 than 两侧被比较的成分必须平行。从句主语 cycling to work 是动名词，than 后面也应用动名词：Many people think that cycling to work is healthier than driving.

instruction: 句中有一处平行结构错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Governments can tackle obesity by taxing sugary drinks, improving school meals and they should build more sports facilities.
accepted: Governments can tackle obesity by taxing sugary drinks, improving school meals and building more sports facilities.
Governments can tackle obesity by taxing sugary drinks, improving school meals, and building more sports facilities.
Governments can tackle obesity by taxing sugary drinks, improving school meals and constructing more sports facilities.
Governments can tackle obesity by taxing sugary drinks, improving school meals, and constructing more sports facilities.
Governments can tackle obesity by taxing sugary drinks, improving school meals and providing more sports facilities.
Governments can tackle obesity by taxing sugary drinks, improving school meals, and providing more sports facilities.
Governments can tackle obesity by taxing sugary drinks, by improving school meals and by building more sports facilities.
Governments can tackle obesity by taxing sugary drinks, by improving school meals, and by building more sports facilities.
criteria: by 后面的三个方式必须都是 -ing 动名词短语，须把 they should build 改为 building（或 constructing / providing 等同义 -ing 形式）；每项前都重复 by 也可以。是否使用牛津逗号均可。须保持原意；其他语法正确的改法也接受。
hints: 找出介词 by 后面列举的三种方法。
介词 by 后面并列的每一项都必须是同一种形式。
前两项是 -ing 形式，第三项却是一个完整的分句。
explanation: 介词 by 后面的三个并列宾语必须都是动名词：by taxing…, improving… and building…。第三项写成 they should build 就变成了独立分句，破坏了平行。改正：Governments can tackle obesity by taxing sugary drinks, improving school meals and building more sports facilities.

instruction: 四个句子都想表达“报告建议城市扩展公交线路并降低票价”。选择平行结构正确的一句。
options: The report suggests that cities should both expand bus routes and lower fares.
The report suggests that cities should both expand bus routes and that they should lower fares.
The report suggests both that cities should expand bus routes and lower fares.
The report suggests that cities should expand both bus routes and lower fares.
option_explanations: 正确：both 和 and 后面都是动词原形短语（expand bus routes / lower fares），完全对称。
错误：both 后是动词短语，and 后却是 that 从句，两边不对称。
错误：both 后是 that 从句，and 后只是动词短语 lower fares，两边不对称。
错误：both 放在 expand 之后，后接名词 bus routes，而 and 后接动词短语 lower fares，两边不对称。
hints: 注意每个句子中 both 的位置。
both…and 是关联连词，紧跟 both 和紧跟 and 的成分必须形式相同。
分别写下 both 后面和 and 后面的第一个成分，比较它们的词性。
explanation: 关联连词 both…and、either…or、not only…but also 的关键在于位置：两个连接词后面的成分必须是同一类。cities should both [expand bus routes] and [lower fares] 两边都是动词短语，正确。both 放错位置（放在 that 前面或 expand 后面）就会让两边不对称。

instruction: 句中关联连词的位置导致平行结构错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Rising sea levels will not only threaten coastal cities but also low-lying farmland in many developing countries.
accepted: Rising sea levels will threaten not only coastal cities but also low-lying farmland in many developing countries.
Rising sea levels will not only threaten coastal cities but also threaten low-lying farmland in many developing countries.
Rising sea levels will threaten not only coastal cities but low-lying farmland in many developing countries as well.
Not only coastal cities but also low-lying farmland in many developing countries will be threatened by rising sea levels.
criteria: not only 和 but also 后面的成分必须相同：把 not only 移到 threaten 之后，使两边都是名词短语（threaten not only coastal cities but also low-lying farmland…）；或在 but also 后补上 threaten，使两边都是动词短语。须保持原意；其他语法正确的平行改法也接受。
hints: 分别看 not only 和 but also 后面紧跟的是什么词性。
关联连词应该紧挨在被对比的两个成分前面。
被对比的是两个“受威胁的对象”，想一想 not only 应该放在动词前还是动词后。
explanation: 原句 not only 后是动词短语 threaten coastal cities，but also 后却是名词短语 low-lying farmland，不对称。被对比的其实是两个宾语，所以 not only 应移到动词之后：Rising sea levels will threaten not only coastal cities but also low-lying farmland in many developing countries. 这是学习者（甚至母语者）都常犯的位置错误。

instruction: 选择正确的搭配填空。
content: Before making a final decision, the committee needs to ______ the issue carefully.
options: discuss
discuss about
discuss on
discuss with
option_explanations: 正确：discuss 是及物动词，直接接宾语 the issue。
错误：discuss 本身已含“讨论某事”的意思，不能加 about（受汉语“讨论关于……”影响）；名词 discussion 才可以接 about / of。
错误：discuss 后面不加 on。
错误：discuss with 后面接的是“人”（discuss sth with sb），不能接 the issue。
hints: 注意空格后面直接就是宾语 the issue。
有些英语动词是及物动词，后面不需要介词。
想一想“讨论某事”在英语里是否真的需要一个介词。
explanation: discuss 是及物动词：discuss the issue / discuss sth with sb。中国学生常受“讨论关于”影响写成 discuss about。类似的还有 emphasize（不加 on）、mention（不加 about）。正确句：Before making a final decision, the committee needs to discuss the issue carefully.

instruction: 句中有一处动词与名词搭配不当，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: By reading widely, students can learn knowledge about other cultures.
accepted: By reading widely, students can acquire knowledge about other cultures.
By reading widely, students can gain knowledge about other cultures.
By reading widely, students can obtain knowledge about other cultures.
By reading widely, students can acquire knowledge of other cultures.
By reading widely, students can gain knowledge of other cultures.
By reading widely, students can obtain knowledge of other cultures.
By reading widely, students can broaden their knowledge of other cultures.
By reading widely, students can expand their knowledge of other cultures.
By reading widely, students can learn about other cultures.
criteria: 必须把 learn knowledge 改为地道搭配，如 acquire / gain / obtain knowledge（about / of）、broaden / expand their knowledge of，或直接改为 learn about other cultures。其他部分可不变；其他地道且语法正确的改法也接受。
hints: 注意动词 learn 后面接的名词。
knowledge 有固定搭配的动词，learn 通常不直接接 knowledge 作宾语。
想一想“获得/获取”知识用哪个动词，或者干脆让 learn 后面接一个介词。
explanation: 汉语“学习知识”不能直译成 learn knowledge。knowledge 常与 acquire / gain / obtain 搭配，也可以说 broaden one's knowledge of sth 或 learn about sth。正确句：By reading widely, students can acquire knowledge about other cultures. 或 …can learn about other cultures.

instruction: 选择最地道的词填空。
content: In many big cities, housing prices are now too ______ for young graduates.
options: expensive
high
big
costly
option_explanations: 错误：expensive 形容物品本身（Housing is expensive），price 本身不能说 expensive；这是“价格很贵”的直译。
正确：price 的地道搭配是 high / low（prices are high / rising）。
错误：big 不与 price 搭配。
错误：costly 和 expensive 一样形容物品或行为“昂贵”，不用来形容 price。
hints: 注意空格描述的主语是 prices，而不是 housing。
英语中形容“物品”贵贱的词和形容“价格”的词并不相同。
price、cost、salary、rate 这类表示数值的名词，要用描述数值大小（而不是物品贵贱）的形容词。
explanation: 英语中物品 expensive / cheap，而价格 high / low。汉语“价格很贵”直译成 the price is expensive 是常见错误。正确句：In many big cities, housing prices are now too high for young graduates. 也可以说 Housing is now too expensive for young graduates.

instruction: 句中有一处动词与介词的搭配错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: The report emphasizes on the importance of early childhood education.
accepted: The report emphasizes the importance of early childhood education.
The report emphasises the importance of early childhood education.
The report places emphasis on the importance of early childhood education.
The report places great emphasis on the importance of early childhood education.
The report puts emphasis on the importance of early childhood education.
The report lays emphasis on the importance of early childhood education.
The report stresses the importance of early childhood education.
The report highlights the importance of early childhood education.
The report underscores the importance of early childhood education.
criteria: 必须去掉 emphasizes 后多余的 on（动词 emphasize 直接接宾语），或改为名词结构 place / put / lay emphasis on。改用 stress / highlight / underscore 等同义及物动词也可。其他部分不变即可；其他地道且语法正确的改法也接受。
hints: 看动词 emphasizes 和紧跟在它后面的词。
动词 emphasize 和名词 emphasis 的搭配方式不同。
动词形式是及物动词；如果想保留介词，就要换成名词形式。
explanation: emphasize 是及物动词，直接接宾语：emphasize the importance of…。只有名词 emphasis 才与 on 搭配：place / put emphasis on…。中国学生常把两者混在一起写成 emphasize on。正确句：The report emphasizes the importance of early childhood education.

instruction: 选择正确的动词填空。
content: To reduce plastic waste, governments must ______ immediate action.
options: make
do
put
take
option_explanations: 错误：action 不与 make 搭配（make 常与 decision、progress、an effort 搭配）。
错误：do action 不地道，do 常与 research、harm、damage 搭配。
错误：put action 不是英语搭配。
正确：take action 是固定搭配，意为“采取行动”；同类还有 take measures / take steps。
hints: 这里考的是“动词 + action”的固定搭配。
“采取行动/措施/步骤”在英语中用的是同一个动词。
想一想 ___ measures、___ steps 中用的是哪个动词。
explanation: take action / take measures / take steps 都表示“采取行动/措施”。make 与 decision、progress、an effort 搭配，do 与 research、harm、damage 搭配。正确句：To reduce plastic waste, governments must take immediate action.

instruction: 句中有一处动词与名词搭配不当，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: This policy will bring a great influence on local businesses.
accepted: This policy will have a great influence on local businesses.
This policy will exert a great influence on local businesses.
This policy will have a great impact on local businesses.
This policy will have a great effect on local businesses.
This policy will have a significant influence on local businesses.
This policy will have a significant impact on local businesses.
This policy will have a profound influence on local businesses.
This policy will have a major impact on local businesses.
This policy will greatly influence local businesses.
This policy will greatly affect local businesses.
criteria: 必须把 bring…influence on 改为地道搭配：have / exert an influence on，或 have an impact / effect on，也可改为动词 greatly influence / affect。须保留 on local businesses 的意思；其他地道且语法正确的改法也接受。
hints: 注意 influence 前面的动词。
influence / impact / effect 后接 on 时，前面常用的动词并不是 bring。
把汉语“带来影响”换成英语里“具有/施加影响”的说法。
explanation: 汉语“带来影响”直译成 bring an influence on 不地道。influence / impact / effect 通常与 have 搭配（have a great influence / impact / effect on），正式语体中也可用 exert an influence on。正确句：This policy will have a great influence on local businesses.

instruction: 选择能使句子搭配正确的一组词。
content: Social media can play an important ______ in ______ public awareness of environmental issues.
options: function … arising
effect … rising
role … raising
role … rising
option_explanations: 错误：play a function 不是地道搭配；arise 是不及物动词，不能接宾语 public awareness。
错误：play an effect 不地道（应为 have an effect）；rise 是不及物动词，不能带宾语。
正确：play a role in 是固定搭配；raise awareness（提高意识）是地道的动宾搭配，raise 是及物动词。
错误：play a role 正确，但 rise 是不及物动词，不能接宾语 public awareness。
hints: 这题有两个空：一个考“play + 名词”，一个考“动词 + awareness”。
注意 rise / raise / arise 中哪个是及物动词，可以直接接宾语。
“在……中发挥作用”和“提高意识”都有固定说法。
explanation: play a role / part in doing sth 意为“在……中发挥作用”；raise awareness of sth 意为“提高对……的意识”。raise 是及物动词（raise sth），rise 和 arise 是不及物动词，不能接宾语。正确句：Social media can play an important role in raising public awareness of environmental issues.

instruction: 句中有一处动词与名词搭配不当，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: The government has adopted a series of measures to solve air pollution.
accepted: The government has adopted a series of measures to tackle air pollution.
The government has adopted a series of measures to address air pollution.
The government has adopted a series of measures to combat air pollution.
The government has adopted a series of measures to reduce air pollution.
The government has adopted a series of measures to curb air pollution.
The government has adopted a series of measures to fight air pollution.
The government has adopted a series of measures to control air pollution.
The government has adopted a series of measures to solve the problem of air pollution.
criteria: 必须替换 solve air pollution 的搭配：solve 通常与 problem / puzzle / mystery 等“待解决的问题”类名词搭配，pollution 本身不属于这类名词。可改为 tackle / address / combat / reduce / curb / fight / control air pollution，或 solve the problem of air pollution。其他部分不变；其他地道且语法正确的改法也接受。
hints: 句子语法没有问题，问题出在表示目的的那部分里动词与宾语的搭配上。
solve 后面通常接哪一类名词？pollution 属于这一类吗？
对付 pollution、crime、poverty 这类“现象”，英语常用表示“应对/遏制/减少”的动词。
explanation: solve 的宾语一般是 problem、puzzle、equation、mystery 等“待解决的问题”；pollution、crime、unemployment 这类现象通常与 tackle、address、combat、reduce、curb 搭配。汉语“解决污染”直译成 solve air pollution 是典型的搭配错误。正确句：The government has adopted a series of measures to tackle air pollution. 或 …to solve the problem of air pollution.

instruction: 选择最精确、最适合学术写作的词填空。
content: Research shows that regular exercise is ______ for mental health.
options: beneficial
good
nice
great
option_explanations: 正确：beneficial 明确表示“有益的”，语义精确且符合学术语体。
不佳：good 过于空泛，不能说明“好在哪里”，学术写作中应避免反复使用。
错误：nice 是口语化的评价词，意为“令人愉快的”，不能说明对健康的作用。
错误：great 是口语强调词，空泛且不正式。
hints: 四个词都可以表示“好”，但精确程度和语体不同。
学术写作要选能说明“具体怎样好”的词。
选那个明确表示“对……有益处”的形容词。
explanation: good / nice / great 都是空泛的评价词，读者无法知道“好”具体指什么。beneficial for / to 明确表示“有益”，更精确也更正式：Research shows that regular exercise is beneficial for mental health.

instruction: 选择最精确的名词填空。
content: Another ______ that affects students' academic performance is the amount of sleep they get.
options: thing
stuff
factor
point
option_explanations: 不佳：thing 是万能词，没有说明它与“学习成绩”之间的关系。
错误：stuff 是口语词，而且是不可数名词，不能与 another 连用。
正确：factor 指“影响结果的因素”，与 affects 语义完全吻合。
错误：point 指“观点/论点”，观点本身不会“影响学习成绩”，语义不搭。
hints: 空格后面的动词是 affects，空格里的名词应该表示能影响结果的东西。
用具体名词代替 thing：问自己它在句中扮演什么角色。
哪个词的意思就是“影响某个结果的原因之一”？
explanation: thing 和 stuff 是空泛词。句中说“另一个影响成绩的 ___”，最精确的是 factor（因素）。类似地，thing 可以依语境换成 issue、measure、advantage、problem 等。正确句：Another factor that affects students' academic performance is the amount of sleep they get.

instruction: 选择最能精确说明影响性质的词填空。
content: Studies suggest that air pollution has a ______ impact on children's lung development.
options: big
very bad
huge
detrimental
option_explanations: 不佳：big 只说明“大”，没说明是好是坏，而且偏口语。
错误：very bad 空泛且不正式，“very + 空泛形容词”是学术写作中应避免的组合。
不佳：huge 是口语化的夸张词，只表示程度，仍没有说明影响的性质。
正确：detrimental 明确表示“有害的”，既说明了影响的性质，又符合学术语体。
hints: 读者需要知道的是：这种影响是好还是坏？
big / huge 只说明大小，精确的用词还应说明影响的性质。
选那个本身就含有“有害”意思的正式形容词。
explanation: big、huge 只说“大”，very bad 空泛且口语化。detrimental（有害的）同时传达影响的性质和正式语体，类似的词还有 adverse、harmful、damaging。正确句：Studies suggest that air pollution has a detrimental impact on children's lung development.

instruction: 选择最精确、最正式的表达，替换句中的 do more things。
content: Governments should do more things to help the long-term unemployed.
options: do more works
take further measures
make more stuff
do more things like that
option_explanations: 错误：work 表示“工作”时是不可数名词，works 意为“作品/工厂”，而且 do 仍然空泛。
正确：take measures 是地道的正式搭配，measures 具体指“措施”；further 表示“进一步的”，比 more 更自然。
错误：make stuff 口语化，意思是“制造东西”，与原意不符。
错误：仍然是空泛的 do things，like that 指代不明，而且更口语化。
hints: do 和 things 都是空泛词，需要同时换掉。
政府为解决社会问题推出的具体行动，在议论文中通常用一个具体名词表示，并与固定的动词搭配。
排除仍含 do、stuff 或有语法错误的选项，再看剩下的“动词 + 名词”组合是否地道。
explanation: do + things 是最空泛的组合之一。政府采取的“事”应具体化为 measures / steps / action，并配上地道动词 take。正确句：Governments should take further measures to help the long-term unemployed. 写作时还可以进一步说明是什么措施，如 provide retraining programmes。

instruction: 选择对原句改写得最精确的一项（意思一致，并且能让读者知道“具体怎样”）。
content: Technology has changed education a lot, and this is a good thing.
options: Technology has changed education very much, and this is a very good thing.
Technology has transformed education in a great way, which is good.
Technology has had a big and good influence on many things in education.
Technology has transformed education, most notably by giving students in remote areas access to high-quality online courses.
option_explanations: 不佳：只是给空泛词加上 very，仍未说明变化是什么、好在哪里。
不佳：transformed 比 changed 精确，但 in a great way 和 good 仍然空泛。
不佳：big、good、many things 堆砌空泛词，读者仍不知道具体影响是什么。
正确：transformed 说明了变化的程度，并用具体例子（偏远地区学生获得优质在线课程）说明“好在哪里”。
hints: 比较各选项：读完后，你能说出“技术具体怎样改变了教育”吗？
精确用词不只是换“更大的词”，而是用具体的动词、名词和例子代替 a lot、good。
选那个写出了具体受益人群和具体好处的选项。
explanation: a lot、a good thing 让论点空洞。精确改写有两步：①用更有力的动词（changed a lot → transformed）；②用具体信息代替评价词（good → 具体说明谁受益、如何受益）。示例：Technology has transformed education, most notably by giving students in remote areas access to high-quality online courses.

instruction: 改写句子，把空泛的 big 和 does bad things to 换成精确的表达，意思不变。
content: Plastic waste is a big problem because it does bad things to sea animals.
accepted: Plastic waste is a serious problem because it harms marine animals.
Plastic waste is a serious environmental problem because it injures and kills marine animals that swallow it or become entangled in it.
Plastic waste poses a severe threat to marine life because sea animals often swallow it or become trapped in it.
criteria: 1）必须替换 big：改为 serious / severe / major / pressing 等能说明问题性质或严重程度的词；2）必须替换 does bad things to：改为 harms / injures / kills / poisons / endangers / threatens 等具体动词，或进一步说明伤害方式；3）不得出现新的空泛词（good、bad、thing、stuff、very、a lot）；4）保留原意（塑料垃圾是严重问题，原因是伤害海洋动物）；5）语法正确。
hints: 找出句中两处空泛表达：一处形容 problem，一处描述塑料对动物“做了什么”。
形容问题时说明它有多严重；描述行为时用一个具体动词代替 do bad things。
想一想塑料垃圾究竟会给海洋动物造成什么后果（如误食、缠绕），再用相应的动词表达。
explanation: big problem 只说明“大”，可改为 serious / severe problem；does bad things to 用了两个空泛词，应换成具体动词 harms / injures / kills，最好再说明伤害方式（swallow it, become entangled in it）。示例：Plastic waste is a serious environmental problem because it injures and kills marine animals that swallow it or become entangled in it.

instruction: 改写句子，消除所有空泛表达（a good thing、get、a lot of good stuff），并用具体名词说明学生能从网上获得什么。
content: The Internet is a good thing for students because they can get a lot of good stuff online.
accepted: The Internet is a valuable resource for students because it gives them free access to academic articles, online courses and expert lectures.
The Internet is an invaluable learning tool for students, as it allows them to access e-books, research databases and recorded lectures.
criteria: 1）把 a good thing 改为 a valuable resource / a powerful learning tool 等能说明作用的具体表达；2）把 get 改为 access / obtain / find 等更精确的动词或结构；3）把 a lot of good stuff 改为具体名词（如学术文章、电子书、在线课程、讲座、数据库等，至少写出一项具体内容）；4）不出现新的空泛词（good、thing、stuff、very、a lot of）；5）保留原意；6）语法正确。
hints: 这句话里有三处空泛表达：对 Internet 的评价、动词，以及学生得到的“东西”。
用“资源/工具”这类具体名词说明网络的作用，再用具体名词列出学生获得的内容。
想象一个大学生上网学习时真正会用到的东西，把它们写进句子里。
explanation: a good thing、get、good stuff 都无法让读者知道互联网对学生到底有什么用。精确的写法是：把评价词换成功能名词（a valuable resource），把 get 换成 access / obtain，把 stuff 换成具体内容（academic articles, online courses）。示例：The Internet is a valuable resource for students because it gives them free access to academic articles, online courses and expert lectures.

instruction: 把下面这段话改写成 1-2 个精确的句子：去掉所有 good / bad / thing / sides，并把“方便”和“让人感觉不好”具体化。
content: Working from home has good and bad sides. The good thing is that it is convenient. The bad thing is that it can make people feel bad.
accepted: Working from home offers both advantages and drawbacks: it eliminates long commutes, but it can leave employees feeling isolated from their colleagues.
Although working from home saves employees the time and stress of commuting, it can also lead to loneliness and blur the boundary between work and personal life.
criteria: 1）写成 1-2 句；2）不得出现 good、bad、thing、sides、stuff 等空泛词；3）必须把 convenient 具体化（如省去通勤、时间安排灵活等）；4）必须把 make people feel bad 具体化为某种具体的负面影响（如孤独、与同事隔离、压力大、工作与生活界限模糊等）；5）保留“有利有弊”的对比关系（but / although / while / however 等）；6）语法正确、语体正式。
hints: 原文三句话其实只有一个意思：在家办公有利有弊。想想“利”和“弊”具体是什么。
good and bad sides 可以换成一对正式名词；convenient 和 feel bad 需要用具体结果来解释。
问自己：在家办公省掉了什么？员工可能产生哪种具体的负面感受？
explanation: 原段落反复使用 good / bad / thing，却没有给出任何具体信息。改写时：①good and bad sides → advantages and drawbacks；②convenient → eliminates long commutes / allows flexible schedules；③make people feel bad → feel isolated / experience stress；④用 although / but 把利弊合进同一句。示例：Although working from home saves employees the time and stress of commuting, it can also lead to loneliness and blur the boundary between work and personal life.

instruction: 选择最适合学术议论文的词填空。
content: Many ______ now spend more time on screens than outdoors.
options: kids
little ones
children
guys
option_explanations: 错误：kids 是口语词，学术写作中应使用 children。
错误：little ones 是亲昵的口语说法，不适合议论文。
正确：children 是中性、正式的表达。
错误：guys 是非常口语化的俚语，而且通常不用来指儿童。
hints: 四个选项意思相近，区别在于正式程度。
学术写作避免口语词和俚语。
选那个你会在正式研究报告中看到的词。
explanation: kids、guys、little ones 都是口语表达。学术议论文应使用中性正式的词：children / young people / teenagers。正确句：Many children now spend more time on screens than outdoors.

instruction: 选择语体最适合学术议论文的句子。
options: It's clear that the government doesn't spend enough on public transport.
Obviously, the government doesn't spend enough on public transport, right?
It's super clear the government isn't spending enough on public transport.
It is clear that the government does not spend enough on public transport.
option_explanations: 不当：含有缩写 It's 和 doesn't，学术写作中应写完整形式。
不当：既有缩写，又以 right? 结尾向读者发问，是口语对话的语气。
不当：super 是口语强调词，且含两处缩写。
正确：没有缩写和口语词，语气客观正式。
hints: 找每个句子里的撇号（'）和口语词。
学术写作不用缩写，也不用口语强调词或附加疑问。
选一个完全没有撇号、也没有 super、right? 这类词的句子。
explanation: 学术语体要求：不用缩写（It's → It is，doesn't → does not），不用口语强调词（super、really），不用附加疑问（…, right?）。正确句：It is clear that the government does not spend enough on public transport.

instruction: 原句使用了泛指的 you。选择最符合学术语体的改写。
content: If you exercise regularly, you will feel more energetic.
options: People who exercise regularly tend to feel more energetic.
If you exercise regularly, you'll feel more energetic.
If one exercise regularly, you will feel more energetic.
If we exercise regularly, you will feel more energetic.
option_explanations: 正确：用 People 作主语代替泛指的 you，表达客观；tend to 还让论断更谨慎。
不当：仍使用泛指的 you，并且加入了缩写 you'll，更不正式。
错误：one 作主语时动词应为 exercises，而且后半句又换成 you，人称前后不一致。
错误：前半句用 we，后半句用 you，人称前后不一致。
hints: 原句的问题在于主语 you——作者在对谁说话？
学术写作中，用具体的人群名词或被动结构代替泛指的 you，并保持人称一致。
选一个既没有 you、主语与动词又完全一致的句子。
explanation: 泛指的 you 让文章像在和读者聊天，不够客观。学术写作应改用具体的人群（people、students、adults）、one（注意动词用单三）或被动语态，并保持人称前后一致。正确句：People who exercise regularly tend to feel more energetic.

instruction: 选择最适合学术写作的表达填空。
content: ______ research has shown that sleep plays a key role in memory formation.
options: A lot of
A considerable amount of
Lots of
Tons of
option_explanations: 不当：a lot of 语法正确，但偏口语，学术写作中应换成更正式的表达。
正确：a considerable amount of 修饰不可数名词 research，正式得体。
不当：lots of 比 a lot of 更口语化。
不当：tons of 是夸张的俚语表达。
hints: 四个选项都表示“很多”，区别在于正式程度。
research 是不可数名词，正式写作中常用 a great deal of 一类的表达修饰。
选那个你最可能在学术期刊中看到的表达。
explanation: a lot of、lots of、tons of 都偏口语。正式写作中，不可数名词前用 a great deal of / a considerable amount of / much，可数名词前用 many / a large number of / numerous。正确句：A considerable amount of research has shown that sleep plays a key role in memory formation.

instruction: 下面哪个句子完全符合学术语体（没有任何口语成分）？
options: Admittedly, online learning has some pretty serious drawbacks.
Admittedly, online learning has got some serious drawbacks.
Admittedly, online learning has a bunch of serious drawbacks.
Admittedly, online learning has a number of serious drawbacks.
option_explanations: 不当：pretty 表示“相当”时是口语副词，正式写作中用 fairly / rather，或直接删去。
不当：has got 是口语（尤其是英式口语）表达，正式写作中用 has。
不当：a bunch of 是口语，意为“一堆”。
正确：a number of 正式、中性，整个句子没有口语成分。
hints: 四个句子只有一两个词不同，先找出这些不同之处。
有些看似普通的词（如 pretty、got、bunch）在正式写作中其实属于口语。
逐个问：这个词会出现在大学教材或学术期刊中吗？
explanation: 口语成分不只是 kids、stuff 这类明显的词，还包括 pretty（相当）、has got、a bunch of 等较隐蔽的口语表达。正式写法：a number of / several / fairly / has。正确句：Admittedly, online learning has a number of serious drawbacks.

instruction: 把句子改写成正式的学术语体，意思不变。
content: Kids these days spend a lot of time on their phones, and it's really bad for their eyes.
accepted: Children today spend a great deal of time on their phones, which can be harmful to their eyesight.
Nowadays, children spend a considerable amount of time on their smartphones, and this habit can damage their eyesight.
Children today spend a great deal of time on mobile phones, which is detrimental to their eyesight.
criteria: 1）kids 改为 children / young people 等正式名词；2）a lot of 改为 a great deal of / a considerable amount of / much 等正式表达；3）不得有缩写（it's 等）；4）really bad 改为 harmful / damaging / detrimental 等正式词；5）these days 可保留，也可改为 today / nowadays；6）保留原意（孩子使用手机时间长、对眼睛有害）；7）语法正确。
hints: 这句话里至少有四处口语成分，可以从名词、数量表达、缩写和形容词四方面去找。
把每处口语表达换成你会在正式报告中看到的说法。
really bad for 可以换成一个本身就表示“有害”的正式形容词。
explanation: 原句有四处口语成分：kids → children；a lot of → a great deal of；it's → it is（或改写句子结构）；really bad → harmful。示例：Children today spend a great deal of time on their phones, which can be harmful to their eyesight.

instruction: 改写句子：去掉所有泛指的 you、缩写和口语词，使其符合学术语体，逻辑不变。
content: If you don't have a degree, you'll find it hard to get a good job, so you should go to uni.
accepted: People without a university degree often find it difficult to secure well-paid employment, so pursuing higher education is advisable.
Those who lack a degree may struggle to obtain a well-paid job; therefore, attending university is a sensible choice.
criteria: 1）不得出现泛指的 you（改用 people / those / individuals / young people 或被动语态等）；2）不得有缩写（don't、you'll）；3）uni 改为 university / higher education；4）get a good job 改为更正式、更精确的说法（如 secure / obtain well-paid employment）；5）保留“没有学位 → 难找好工作 → 建议上大学”的逻辑；6）语法正确。so 可保留，也可改为 therefore / thus。
hints: 数一数句子里有几个 you，以及有几处撇号。
用一个具体的人群名词作主语，并把 uni、get a good job 等口语换成正式表达。
最后的“你应该上大学”可以变成一个不针对读者的客观建议，例如用 -ing 短语作主语。
explanation: 学术写作不直接对读者说话：泛指的 you 改为 people / those / individuals；缩写写成完整形式；uni → university；get a good job → secure well-paid employment；you should go to uni → pursuing higher education is advisable。示例：People without a university degree often find it difficult to secure well-paid employment, so pursuing higher education is advisable.

instruction: 把这段口语化的文字改写成 2-3 句正式的学术段落，保留全部信息。
content: So, what's the deal with fast food? Well, it's cheap and you can get it anywhere, but it's got loads of fat and salt. That's why lots of people are getting fat!
accepted: Fast food is popular largely because it is inexpensive and widely available. However, it contains high levels of fat and salt, which is a major reason why obesity rates are rising.
Fast food appeals to many consumers because it is inexpensive and easy to obtain. Nevertheless, its high fat and salt content contributes significantly to the growing prevalence of obesity.
criteria: 1）写成 2-3 句正式的陈述句；2）删除反问开头（what's the deal…?）、So / Well 等口头禅和感叹号；3）没有缩写，没有泛指的 you；4）口语词全部替换：loads of / lots of → high levels of / many 等，getting fat → obesity / becoming overweight，it's got → contains / has，get it anywhere → widely available 等；5）保留三点信息：便宜、随处可得、高脂高盐导致很多人肥胖；6）使用恰当的衔接词（However / Nevertheless / therefore 等）；7）语法正确。
hints: 先把原文的信息提炼成三点，再考虑怎么正式地表达。
要处理的口语特征包括：反问、口头禅、感叹号、缩写、you、loads of / lots of、getting fat。
用 Fast food 直接作第一句的主语，再用一个正式的转折词引出健康问题。
explanation: 学术段落应直接陈述观点，不用反问和 So / Well 开头，也不用感叹号。口语词替换：cheap → inexpensive，you can get it anywhere → widely available，it's got loads of → contains high levels of，lots of people are getting fat → obesity rates are rising。示例：Fast food is popular largely because it is inexpensive and widely available. However, it contains high levels of fat and salt, which is a major reason why obesity rates are rising.

instruction: 选择最简洁且意思不变的版本。
content: In my personal opinion, I think that school uniforms should be abolished.
options: In my personal opinion, I believe that school uniforms should be abolished.
I think that, in my opinion, school uniforms should be abolished.
I believe that school uniforms should be abolished.
Personally, in my view, I think school uniforms should be abolished.
option_explanations: 冗余：in my personal opinion 与 I believe 意思重复，personal 与 my 也重复。
冗余：I think 与 in my opinion 表达的是同一个意思。
正确：只用一个观点标记 I believe，简洁明确。
冗余：Personally、in my view、I think 三重重复。
hints: 数一数每个选项里有几个表示“我认为”的表达。
表达观点时，一个观点标记就足够了。
选只保留一个观点标记的选项。
explanation: in my opinion、personally、I think、I believe 都表示“我认为”，只需用一个；personal 与 my 也重复。正确句：I believe that school uniforms should be abolished. 在议论文中，有时连 I believe 也可以省去，直接陈述论点。

instruction: 选择能替换 Due to the fact that 的最简洁且语法正确的表达。
content: Due to the fact that public transport is cheap, many students use it every day.
options: Because
Owing to the fact that
Due to
Because of the reason that
option_explanations: 正确：because 一个词就表达了原因，后接完整分句，简洁准确。
冗余：owing to the fact that 与原短语同样冗长。
错误：due to 是介词短语，后面只能接名词，不能直接接完整分句 public transport is cheap。
冗余：because 与 the reason 意思重复。
hints: the fact that 这类结构往往可以压缩成一个词。
引导原因状语从句时，最简单的连词是哪个？
还要注意：介词后面不能直接接完整的句子。
explanation: due to the fact that、owing to the fact that、in view of the fact that 都可以压缩为 because（或 since / as）。注意 due to 是介词，后面只能接名词短语。正确句：Because public transport is cheap, many students use it every day.

instruction: 选择没有冗余表达的句子。
options: The reason why many graduates return back to their hometowns is because living costs are lower.
Many graduates return to their hometowns because living costs are lower there.
Many graduates go back and return to their hometowns because living costs are lower.
The main reason is because living costs are lower, and that is why many graduates return to their hometowns.
option_explanations: 冗余：return back 中 back 多余；the reason why…is because 中 reason 与 because 重复（应为 the reason…is that）。
正确：没有重复，直接用 because 说明原因。
冗余：go back 和 return 意思相同。
冗余：the reason is because 重复，and that is why 又再次说明原因，信息绕了一圈。
hints: 注意 return、back、reason、because 这些词在句中的组合。
return 本身就含“回”的意思；reason 本身就含“原因”的意思。
选一个每个词都不能删掉的句子。
explanation: 常见的同义重复：return back（return 已含 back 的意思）、the reason why…is because（reason 与 because 重复，应为 the reason is that…，或直接用 because）、go back and return。正确句：Many graduates return to their hometowns because living costs are lower there.

instruction: 选择最简洁且意思不变的版本。
content: There are many students who work part-time while they are studying.
options: There are many students that work part-time while they are studying.
Many students, they work part-time while studying.
It is many students who work part-time while studying.
Many students work part-time while studying.
option_explanations: 冗余：只把 who 换成 that，There are…that 的空结构和 they are 都保留了。
错误：Many students 后面又加主语 they，属于主语重复，语法错误。
错误：It is…who 是强调句，改变了句子的意思和重点，也不自然。
正确：去掉 There are…who 的空结构，让 students 直接作主语；while they are studying 简化为 while studying。
hints: There are…who… 这种句型里，真正的主语和谓语是什么？
There be + 名词 + 定语从句 常常可以压缩为“名词 + 动词”。
while 从句的主语与主句相同时，“主语 + be”可以省略。
explanation: There are many students who work… 中的 There are 和 who 只是空壳，真正的信息是 students work。让名词直接作主语更简洁；while they are studying 在主语一致时可省略为 while studying。正确句：Many students work part-time while studying.

instruction: 选择最简洁、且没有丢失任何信息的改写。
content: The committee made a decision to carry out an investigation into the causes of the accident.
options: The committee made a decision to investigate into the causes of the accident.
The committee decided to carry out an investigation into the causes of the accident.
The committee decided to investigate the causes of the accident.
The committee decided to investigate.
option_explanations: 错误：仍保留 made a decision；而且 investigate 是及物动词，后面不加 into。
不够简洁：made a decision 已改为 decided，但 carry out an investigation into 仍可压缩为 investigate。
正确：把两个名词化结构都还原为动词（decided、investigate），信息完整。
错误：过度删减，丢失了 the causes of the accident 这一关键信息。
hints: 句中有两个“动词 + 名词”结构，其中的名词本身就可以作动词用。
make a decision、carry out an investigation 都可以还原为单个动词。
简洁不等于删掉内容：调查的对象必须保留。
explanation: 名词化结构（make a decision、carry out an investigation into）会让句子拖沓。把名词还原为动词：make a decision → decide，carry out an investigation into → investigate（及物动词，不加 into）。但不能删掉必要信息。正确句：The committee decided to investigate the causes of the accident.

instruction: 删去套话和重复，把句子改写得更简洁（不超过约 12 个词），核心意思不变。
content: As we all know, in today's modern society, the Internet plays a very important role in our daily lives.
accepted: The Internet plays a central role in daily life.
The Internet has become essential to everyday life.
Today, the Internet plays a vital role in everyday life.
criteria: 1）删除套话 As we all know；2）删除 in today's modern society 的重复（today's 与 modern 重复，可整体删除或压缩为 today / now）；3）very important 可改为 central / vital / essential 等单个词，或保留 important 去掉 very；4）保留核心意思：互联网在日常生活中作用重要；5）不超过约 12 个词（原句 19 词）；6）语法正确。
hints: 找出句首两个没有实际信息的短语。
As we all know 是套话；today's 和 modern 意思重复；very + 形容词可以换成一个更有力的词。
只保留“谁 + 起什么作用 + 在哪里”这一主干。
explanation: As we all know 是中国学生常用的套话，不提供任何信息；in today's modern society 中 today's 与 modern 重复；very important 可用 vital / central 一个词替代。示例：The Internet plays a central role in daily life.（9 词，信息不变）

instruction: 把句子改写得更简洁（不超过 20 个词），保留全部信息。
content: In order to solve the problem of traffic congestion, it is necessary for the government to make an improvement in the public transport system, which is a system that many citizens rely on.
accepted: To reduce traffic congestion, the government must improve the public transport system, on which many citizens rely.
To ease traffic congestion, the government needs to improve the public transport system, which many citizens rely on.
The government must improve public transport, which many citizens depend on, to reduce traffic congestion.
criteria: 1）in order to → to；2）it is necessary for the government to → the government must / should / needs to；3）make an improvement in → improve；4）删除 which is a system that 中重复的 system（可用 on which / which…rely on 等）；5）solve the problem of 可压缩为 tackle / reduce / ease 等；6）保留全部信息：目的（缓解交通拥堵）、主体（政府）、行动（改善公共交通）、许多市民依赖公共交通；7）总字数不超过 20 词（原句 33 词）；8）语法正确。
hints: 这句话里有几处可以“瘦身”：目的短语、it is…for…to 结构、名词化结构和定语从句。
in order to、it is necessary for X to、make an improvement in 都有更短的说法；system 不需要说两次。
让 the government 直接作主语，后面紧跟一个表示“必须”的情态动词和一个简单动词。
explanation: 冗长的来源：in order to（→ to）；solve the problem of（→ tackle / reduce）；it is necessary for the government to（→ the government must）；make an improvement in（→ improve）；which is a system that（重复 system，→ on which / which）。示例：To reduce traffic congestion, the government must improve the public transport system, on which many citizens rely.（17 词，原句 33 词）

instruction: 把下面这段话改写成 1-2 句（不超过 28 个词），删除所有冗余，保留论点和理由。
content: Personally speaking, I strongly believe that it is an undeniable fact that children who are young should be taught how to cook. The reason why I think this is because cooking is a skill that is useful and practical, and it is also a skill that they will use in the future when they grow up.
accepted: I believe that young children should be taught to cook because cooking is a practical skill they will use throughout their lives.
Young children should learn to cook because it is a practical skill they will need as adults.
criteria: 1）写成 1-2 句，不超过 28 词（原文 56 词）；2）观点标记最多保留一个（删去 Personally speaking / it is an undeniable fact 等重复表达）；3）children who are young → young children；4）The reason why I think this is because → because（或 This is because）；5）useful and practical 只保留一个；6）in the future when they grow up 压缩为 as adults / later in life / throughout their lives 等；7）保留论点（幼儿应该学做饭）和理由（实用、将来会用到）；8）语法正确。
hints: 先划出原文中所有表达“我认为”的词组，以及所有说了两遍的意思。
处理冗余的方法：多个观点标记只留一个；定语从句压缩为形容词；reason…because 只留 because；同义词只留一个。
最终句子只需要两部分：“谁应该学做饭” + because + “一个理由”。
explanation: 原文的冗余：①Personally speaking / I strongly believe / it is an undeniable fact 三重观点标记；②children who are young → young children；③The reason why I think this is because 同义重复；④useful and practical 近义重复；⑤a skill that…, a skill that… 重复；⑥in the future when they grow up 意思重复。示例：Young children should learn to cook because it is a practical skill they will need as adults.（17 词）

instruction: 选出标点和句子边界都正确的一项。
options: Smartphones are useful, they can also be distracting.
Smartphones are useful they can also be distracting.
Smartphones are useful, but they can also be distracting.
Smartphones are useful but, they can also be distracting.
option_explanations: 错误：逗号连句。Smartphones are useful 和 they can also be distracting 都是完整句，中间只有逗号，没有连词。
错误：粘连句。两个完整句之间既没有标点也没有连词。
正确：用“逗号 + 并列连词 but”连接两个完整句，表示转折。
错误：逗号位置不对。并列连词前面加逗号，而不是后面；but 后的逗号把连词和它引导的分句隔开了。
hints: 先找出这句话里有几个“主语 + 谓语”组合。
两个完整句不能只靠逗号相连，也不能直接挤在一起，需要连词或更强的标点。
比较各选项：哪个在两个分句之间用了表示转折的连词，并且逗号放在了正确的一侧？
explanation: Smartphones are useful 和 they can also be distracting 都是完整句。两个完整句之间只用逗号是逗号连句，什么都不加是粘连句。正确做法之一是“逗号 + 并列连词”，逗号放在连词之前：Smartphones are useful, but they can also be distracting. 也可以用分号或句号把两句分开。

instruction: 下面的句子有一处句子边界错误（逗号连句），请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Many students work part-time, they need money to pay their rent.
accepted: Many students work part-time because they need money to pay their rent.
Many students work part-time, because they need money to pay their rent.
Many students work part-time as they need money to pay their rent.
Many students work part-time, as they need money to pay their rent.
Many students work part-time since they need money to pay their rent.
Many students work part-time, since they need money to pay their rent.
Many students work part-time, for they need money to pay their rent.
Many students work part-time; they need money to pay their rent.
Many students work part-time. They need money to pay their rent.
Many students work part-time: they need money to pay their rent.
Many students work part-time, and they need money to pay their rent.
Many students need money to pay their rent, so they work part-time.
criteria: 原句是逗号连句：Many students work part-time 和 they need money to pay their rent 两个完整句之间只有逗号。必须用以下任一方式改正：句号、分号、冒号、表示原因的从属连词（because/as/since）、或“逗号 + 并列连词”（如 , for / , and；或调换顺序用 , so）。最好体现因果关系，但用句号、分号或 , and 分开两句同样是正确的改法。必须保留原句全部信息（打工、需要钱付房租）。其他改动只要语法正确、不改变原意均可接受；如果仍是逗号连句、变成粘连句或产生新的语法错误则判错。
hints: 找到句中的逗号，看看逗号前后各是什么结构。
逗号前后都是有主语和谓语的完整句，英语不允许只用逗号连接两个完整句。
第二个分句其实在说明第一个分句的原因，可以考虑用一个表示原因的连词，或者换一个更强的标点。
explanation: Many students work part-time 和 they need money to pay their rent 都是完整句，只用逗号连接属于逗号连句。第二句是第一句的原因，最自然的改法是用 because：Many students work part-time because they need money to pay their rent. 也可以用分号或句号把两句分开。

instruction: 选出唯一一个完整且句子边界正确的选项。
options: Although governments have invested heavily in renewable energy.
Governments have invested heavily in renewable energy, fossil fuels are still widely used.
Although governments have invested heavily in renewable energy. Fossil fuels are still widely used.
Although governments have invested heavily in renewable energy, fossil fuels are still widely used.
option_explanations: 错误：残缺句。Although 引导的是从句，单独使用缺少主句，意思没有说完。
错误：逗号连句。两个完整句之间只有逗号，缺少表示让步或转折的连词。
错误：Although 从句被句号切断，成了残缺句；从句必须和主句写在同一个句子里。
正确：Although 从句 + 逗号 + 主句，结构完整，让步关系清楚。
hints: 注意每个选项里 Although 的作用，以及句号的位置。
Although 引导的是从句，从句不能单独成句，必须依附一个主句。
想一想：Although 从句和主句之间应该用什么标点，它们能不能被句号分开？
explanation: Although 是从属连词，它引导的从句不能单独成句，否则是残缺句（fragment）。而去掉 Although 后，两个完整句只用逗号连接又成了逗号连句。正确结构：Although governments have invested heavily in renewable energy, fossil fuels are still widely used.

instruction: 下面的句子有一处句子边界错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Public transport in big cities is cheap, however, many people still prefer to drive.
accepted: Public transport in big cities is cheap; however, many people still prefer to drive.
Public transport in big cities is cheap. However, many people still prefer to drive.
Public transport in big cities is cheap, but many people still prefer to drive.
Public transport in big cities is cheap, yet many people still prefer to drive.
Although public transport in big cities is cheap, many people still prefer to drive.
Though public transport in big cities is cheap, many people still prefer to drive.
Even though public transport in big cities is cheap, many people still prefer to drive.
Public transport in big cities is cheap; many people, however, still prefer to drive.
Public transport in big cities is cheap. Many people, however, still prefer to drive.
criteria: 原句把副词 however 当作连词，两个完整句之间只有逗号，属于逗号连句。必须改为：however 前用分号或句号（however 后保留逗号）；或改用并列连词 but/yet；或改为 although/though/even though 引导的从句。必须保留“便宜”与“仍然更愿意开车”之间的转折关系和全部信息。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受；如出现 Although…but 等新错误则判错。
hints: 注意 however 前后的标点。
however 是副词，不是连词，它不能像 but 那样用逗号把两个完整句连起来。
要么把 however 前面的逗号换成更强的标点，要么换一个真正的连词。
explanation: however 是连接副词（conjunctive adverb），只在意思上表示转折，语法上不能连接两个完整句，所以 “…is cheap, however, many people…” 是逗号连句。改法：Public transport in big cities is cheap; however, many people still prefer to drive. 或用 but：…is cheap, but many people still prefer to drive.

instruction: 下面是一个粘连句（两个完整句之间没有任何连接）。选出改写正确的一项。
content: Air pollution in the city is getting worse doctors advise people to stay indoors.
options: Air pollution in the city is getting worse, so doctors advise people to stay indoors.
Air pollution in the city is getting worse, doctors advise people to stay indoors.
Air pollution in the city is getting worse, therefore doctors advise people to stay indoors.
Air pollution in the city is getting worse. Which is why doctors advise people to stay indoors.
option_explanations: 正确：用“逗号 + 并列连词 so”连接两个完整句，表示结果。
错误：只加了逗号，仍然是逗号连句。
错误：therefore 是副词，不是连词，前面只用逗号仍是逗号连句；应写成 …worse; therefore, doctors…
错误：Which is why… 是关系从句，单独成句是残缺句。
hints: 原句中有两个完整句，先找到它们的分界点。
连接两个完整句可以用句号、分号，或“逗号 + 并列连词”；副词和关系从句不能独立承担这个任务。
比较各选项中连接两句的词：哪个是并列连词，哪个只是副词或从句引导词？
explanation: Air pollution in the city is getting worse 和 doctors advise people to stay indoors 是两个完整句，中间什么都没有，是粘连句。so 是并列连词，可以用“逗号 + so”连接；therefore 是副词，只能用 “; therefore,” 或另起一句；Which is why… 单独成句则是残缺句。正确：Air pollution in the city is getting worse, so doctors advise people to stay indoors.

instruction: 以下四个选项中只有一个有句子边界错误，请把它找出来。
options: Many young people move to big cities. They hope to find better jobs there.
Many young people move to big cities. Hoping to find better jobs there.
Many young people move to big cities, hoping to find better jobs there.
Hoping to find better jobs, many young people move to big cities.
option_explanations: 没有错误：两个完整句分别用句号结束。
有错误（本题答案）：Hoping to find better jobs there 只是分词短语，没有主语和谓语，单独成句是残缺句。
没有错误：分词短语 hoping to… 用逗号接在主句后面，作伴随状语。
没有错误：分词短语放在句首，后面接逗号和主句。
hints: 逐个检查每个句号前的部分是否有自己的主语和谓语动词。
-ing 分词短语不是完整句，它必须依附在一个主句上。
检查每个 -ing 短语：它和主句在同一个句子里，还是被句号隔开了？
explanation: Hoping to find better jobs there 没有主语，hoping 也不是谓语动词，所以它不能单独成句，否则就是残缺句。把它用逗号接在主句前面或后面，或者补出主语和谓语（They hope to find…），都是正确的写法。只有把分词短语单独用句号隔开的那个选项是错误的。

instruction: 下面的内容有一处句子边界错误（残缺句），请改正并写出完整内容。
content: Many companies now allow employees to work from home. Which reduces traffic during rush hour.
accepted: Many companies now allow employees to work from home, which reduces traffic during rush hour.
Many companies now allow employees to work from home. This reduces traffic during rush hour.
Many companies now allow employees to work from home; this reduces traffic during rush hour.
Many companies now allow employees to work from home, and this reduces traffic during rush hour.
Many companies now allow employees to work from home. This practice reduces traffic during rush hour.
Many companies now allow employees to work from home; this practice reduces traffic during rush hour.
Many companies now allow employees to work from home. This policy reduces traffic during rush hour.
Many companies now allow employees to work from home; this policy reduces traffic during rush hour.
Many companies now allow employees to work from home, and this practice reduces traffic during rush hour.
criteria: Which reduces traffic during rush hour 是关系从句，单独成句为残缺句。必须把它并入前一句（逗号 + which），或改成完整句（如 This / This practice / This policy reduces…，可用句号、分号或“, and”连接）。必须保留“在家办公减少高峰期交通”的全部信息。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受；若改成“, this reduces…”（逗号连句）则判错。
hints: 看第二个句号前的部分：它能单独成句吗？
以 Which 开头的关系从句必须依附在它修饰的内容后面，不能独立。
可以把这个从句接回前一句，或者给它换一个能当主语的词。
explanation: Which reduces traffic during rush hour 是非限定性关系从句，修饰前面整件事，不能单独成句。改法一：Many companies now allow employees to work from home, which reduces traffic during rush hour. 改法二：把 Which 换成 This，使其成为完整句：…from home. This reduces traffic during rush hour.

instruction: 选出没有任何句子边界错误的一项。
options: The government has built more parks, as a result, residents now have more space to exercise, which may improve public health.
The government has built more parks; as a result, residents now have more space to exercise. Which may improve public health.
The government has built more parks as a result residents now have more space to exercise, this may improve public health.
The government has built more parks; as a result, residents now have more space to exercise, which may improve public health.
option_explanations: 错误：as a result 是副词短语，不是连词，前面只用逗号构成逗号连句。
错误：前半部分正确，但 Which may improve public health 被句号隔开，成了残缺句。
错误：前两个分句之间没有任何标点（粘连句），this may improve… 又只用逗号接上（逗号连句）。
正确：分号连接两个完整句，as a result 后加逗号；which 从句用逗号接在句末，修饰前面的情况。
hints: 每个选项都有三个部分，分别检查它们之间是怎样连接的。
as a result 是副词短语而非连词；which 从句不能独立成句；this 开头的是一个完整句。
分别检查 as a result 前用的是什么标点，以及 which 从句是否还和它修饰的内容在同一句里。
explanation: as a result 和 however 一样是副词性连接语，连接两个完整句时前面要用分号或句号。which may improve public health 是关系从句，必须接在主句后面；this may improve… 是完整句，不能只用逗号接上。正确：The government has built more parks; as a result, residents now have more space to exercise, which may improve public health.

instruction: 选出没有中式句型错误的一项。
options: Although online shopping is convenient, but it creates a lot of packaging waste.
Although online shopping is convenient, it creates a lot of packaging waste.
Although online shopping is convenient, however it creates a lot of packaging waste.
option_explanations: 错误：Although 与 but 同时使用，是“虽然……但是……”的直译。英语中二者只能保留一个。
正确：只用 Although 引导让步从句，主句前不再加连词。
错误：Although 后又用 however，同样重复表达转折，而且 however 不能这样引导主句。
hints: 数一数句子中表示“虽然 / 但是”的词一共出现了几个。
英语中 although 不能和 but（或 however）在同一个句子里搭配表示转折。
表示让步转折的词只需要保留一个，看哪个选项做到了这一点。
explanation: 中文说“虽然……但是……”，英语只用一个连词：要么 Although…, …，要么 …, but…。因此 Although online shopping is convenient, it creates a lot of packaging waste. 正确；也可以写 Online shopping is convenient, but it creates a lot of packaging waste.

instruction: 下面的句子有一处中式句型错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Because the rent in big cities is very high, so young people often share flats with friends.
accepted: Because the rent in big cities is very high, young people often share flats with friends.
The rent in big cities is very high, so young people often share flats with friends.
Since the rent in big cities is very high, young people often share flats with friends.
As the rent in big cities is very high, young people often share flats with friends.
Young people often share flats with friends because the rent in big cities is very high.
Young people often share flats with friends since the rent in big cities is very high.
Young people often share flats with friends as the rent in big cities is very high.
criteria: 原句 Because 与 so 同时使用。必须删除 Because 或 so 之一（或改为其他正确的因果表达），保留因果关系和全部信息。删除 Because 时须保留 so 前的逗号。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受（如 flats 换成 apartments）；若仍同时保留 because 和 so 则判错。
hints: 找出句子中表示“因为”和“所以”的词。
英语里 because 和 so 不能在同一句中成对使用。
删掉其中一个连词即可，注意删掉后标点是否仍然正确。
explanation: “因为……所以……”在英语中只用一个连词。删 so：Because the rent in big cities is very high, young people often share flats with friends. 或删 Because：The rent in big cities is very high, so young people often share flats with friends.

instruction: 下面的句子有一处中式句型错误（双谓语），请改正并写出完整句子。
content: There are many people believe that technology makes life easier.
accepted: Many people believe that technology makes life easier.
Many people believe technology makes life easier.
There are many people who believe that technology makes life easier.
There are many people who believe technology makes life easier.
A lot of people believe that technology makes life easier.
criteria: 原句的主句中 are 和 believe 两个谓语动词并存。必须删去 There are，或在 people 后加 who/that 把 believe 变成定语从句。须保留“很多人相信技术让生活更容易”的意思。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 数一数这个句子的主句里有几个谓语动词。
There are 已经是谓语，后面不能再直接跟另一个谓语动词 believe。
要么去掉开头的结构，要么在 people 后面加一个引导定语从句的词。
explanation: There are many people believe… 是“有很多人认为”的直译，一个分句里出现了 are 和 believe 两个谓语。最简洁的改法：Many people believe that technology makes life easier. 也可以写 There are many people who believe that technology makes life easier.（语法正确但较啰嗦）。

instruction: 选出最符合学术写作规范的一项。
options: The reason why many students feel stressed is because they have too many exams.
The reason of many students feel stressed is that they have too many exams.
The reason why many students feel stressed is that they have too many exams.
Because many students have too many exams, so they feel stressed.
option_explanations: 不规范：reason 本身已含“因为”之意，is because 语义重复（“原因是因为”）。这种说法在口语中常见，但学术写作中应改为 is that。
错误：reason of 后不能接完整句 many students feel stressed；应为 the reason why + 句子，或 the reason for + 名词。
正确：The reason why… is that… 是规范的学术表达。
错误：Because 与 so 同时使用，是“因为……所以……”的直译。
hints: 关注表示原因的词：reason、because、so 分别是怎样搭配的。
reason 已经表示“原因”，后面再用 because 是语义重复；because 和 so 也不能同句成对使用。
想一想 is 后面应该用哪个引导词来说明“原因是什么”，并确认 reason 后面的结构是否正确。
explanation: 受中文“原因是因为”的影响，The reason… is because… 很常见，但 reason 和 because 语义重复，学术写作应写 The reason… is that…。另外，the reason of + 句子 和 Because…so… 都是中式结构。正确：The reason why many students feel stressed is that they have too many exams.

instruction: 选出没有中式句型问题的一项。
options: In my hometown, the air it is much cleaner than in Beijing.
My hometown, the air is much cleaner than Beijing.
My hometown's air, it is much cleaner than Beijing.
The air in my hometown is much cleaner than in Beijing.
option_explanations: 错误：主语 the air 后又加代词 it，主语重复。
错误：“我的家乡，空气很好”是中文话题句直译，My hometown 在句中没有语法作用；而且拿 the air 和 Beijing 比较也不对等。
错误：主语后又用 it 重复，且 air 与 Beijing 的比较不对等。
正确：主语 The air in my hometown 清楚明确，比较对象 in Beijing 与 in my hometown 对等。
hints: 找出每个选项真正的主语是什么。
英语句子不用“话题 + 评论”结构，主语也不能再被代词重复一次。
正确选项只有一个主语，并且比较的两样东西要对等（空气和空气比）。
explanation: 中文常说“我的家乡，空气很好”，先摆话题再评论；英语要把话题放进主语里：The air in my hometown…，主语后也不能再用 it 重复。比较时要空气比空气：…much cleaner than in Beijing（或 than the air in Beijing）。正确：The air in my hometown is much cleaner than in Beijing.

instruction: 下面的句子有一处中式句型错误（用完整句直接作主语），请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Students spend too much time on social media can harm their concentration.
accepted: Spending too much time on social media can harm students' concentration.
For students, spending too much time on social media can harm their concentration.
If students spend too much time on social media, it can harm their concentration.
When students spend too much time on social media, it can harm their concentration.
Students who spend too much time on social media can harm their concentration.
Students' spending too much time on social media can harm their concentration.
criteria: 原句把完整句 Students spend too much time on social media 直接当作主语，句中出现 spend 和 can harm 两个谓语。必须改为正确结构，例如动名词短语作主语（Spending…）、条件/时间状语从句（If/When students spend…, it can…）或定语从句（Students who spend…）。须保留“学生花太多时间在社交媒体上会损害注意力”的意思。其他改动只要语法正确、意思不变均可接受；若 their 没有明确指代对象（如 Spending too much time on social media can harm their concentration.）则判错。
hints: 找出这句话的谓语 can harm：它的主语到底是什么？
英语中一个完整的句子不能直接充当另一个句子的主语。
可以把 spend 变成能作主语的非谓语形式，或者把前半句改成从句。
explanation: 中文可以说“学生花太多时间在社交媒体上会损害注意力”，用一个小句当主语；但英语中 Students spend… 是完整句，不能直接作主语。常用改法：Spending too much time on social media can harm students' concentration. 或 If students spend too much time on social media, it can harm their concentration.

instruction: 选出没有中式句型错误的一项。
options: A growing number of graduates choose to start their own businesses.
There is a growing number of graduates choose to start their own businesses.
There are a growing number of graduates choose to start their own businesses.
A growing number of graduates, they choose to start their own businesses.
option_explanations: 正确：A growing number of graduates 作主语，谓语 choose 用复数，结构简洁。
错误：There is 和 choose 两个谓语出现在同一分句中（双谓语）。
错误：同样是双谓语；只把 is 改成 are 并没有解决问题。
错误：主语后又用 they 重复，是中文话题句的影响。
hints: 数一数每个选项中有几个谓语动词。
There be 句型后面不能直接再接一个谓语动词；主语也不能用代词重复。
最简洁的写法往往是直接让“人”做主语。
explanation: There is/are… + 动词 是常见的双谓语错误，把 is 改成 are 也无济于事。直接用名词短语作主语即可：A growing number of graduates choose to start their own businesses.（a number of + 复数名词，谓语用复数。）若想保留 there be，需写成 There are a growing number of graduates who choose…

instruction: 选出没有任何中式句型错误的一项。
options: Although many governments have promoted electric cars, but charging stations are still scarce in rural areas, so drivers there are reluctant to buy them.
Because charging stations are still scarce in rural areas, so drivers there are reluctant to buy electric cars, although governments have promoted them.
There are many drivers in rural areas are reluctant to buy electric cars because charging stations are still scarce.
Although many governments have promoted electric cars, charging stations are still scarce in rural areas, so drivers there remain reluctant to buy them.
option_explanations: 错误：Although 与 but 同时使用。
错误：Because 与 so 同时使用。
错误：There are 与 are reluctant 构成双谓语。
正确：Although 从句 + 主句，再用“逗号 + so”引出结果，每处逻辑关系只用一个连词，每个分句只有一个谓语。
hints: 这几个句子都比较长，逐一检查每对连词和每个分句的谓语。
重点留意三类错误：although…but、because…so，以及 there are + 名词 + 动词。
正确选项中，每处逻辑关系只由一个连词表达，并且每个分句只有一个谓语。
explanation: 长句中更容易出现中式结构：含 Although…but 的选项、含 Because…so 的选项、含 There are many drivers… are… 的选项都是典型错误。正确句子：Although many governments have promoted electric cars, charging stations are still scarce in rural areas, so drivers there remain reluctant to buy them. 其中 although 表示让步，so 表示结果，各司其职。

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Technology ______ our lives easier in many ways.
options: make
making
makes
have made
option_explanations: 错误：Technology 作主语视为第三人称单数，一般现在时动词要加 -s。
错误：making 是非谓语形式，句子会缺少谓语动词。
正确：第三人称单数主语 + makes。
错误：Technology 是单数，现在完成时应用 has made，而不是 have made。
hints: 先确定句子的主语是什么。
这里的 Technology 是不可数名词，作主语时按第三人称单数处理。
一般现在时中，第三人称单数主语后的动词要有什么变化？
explanation: Technology 作主语视为第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语要加 -s：Technology makes our lives easier in many ways. 若用现在完成时，也要用 has made。

instruction: 下面的句子有一处主谓一致错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Each of the students have access to a laptop at school.
accepted: Each of the students has access to a laptop at school.
Each student has access to a laptop at school.
Every student has access to a laptop at school.
All of the students have access to a laptop at school.
All the students have access to a laptop at school.
criteria: 主语核心是 Each（每一个），谓语应为单数。必须把 have 改为 has（或把主语改为 Each student / Every student，或改为 All (of) the students 并保持复数谓语）。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 这句话真正的主语是 Each 还是 students？
each 作主语时，不管后面的 of 短语是什么，谓语都用单数。
把 of the students 括起来，再读一遍主语和动词。
explanation: Each of the students 的核心词是 Each，表示“每一个”，谓语用单数：Each of the students has access to a laptop at school. 不要被紧挨动词的复数名词 students 带偏。

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: The number of international students in Australia ______ risen sharply over the past decade.
options: has
have
are
were
option_explanations: 正确：the number of（……的数量）的核心词是 number，单数，用 has risen。
错误：被 students 带偏了；the number of 后的谓语应为单数。
错误：rise 是不及物动词，不能构成 are risen 这样的被动；而且主语是单数。
错误：were risen 结构错误，rise 不能用于被动；单复数也不对。
hints: 这句话的核心主语是 number 还是 students？
the number of + 复数名词 表示“……的数量”，谓语用单数；a number of 才用复数。
risen 是过去分词：想一想哪个助动词能和它构成完成时，再让它与核心主语的单复数一致。
explanation: the number of… 指“数量”，主语是 number，谓语用单数：The number of international students in Australia has risen sharply over the past decade. 对比：A number of students have… 表示“许多学生”，用复数。

instruction: 下面的句子有一处主谓一致错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: The quality of public schools in many rural areas need to be improved.
accepted: The quality of public schools in many rural areas needs to be improved.
The quality of public schools in many rural areas needs improving.
The quality of public schools in many rural areas needs improvement.
The quality of public schools in many rural areas has to be improved.
The quality of public schools in many rural areas must be improved.
The quality of public schools in many rural areas should be improved.
criteria: 主语核心是 The quality（单数），谓语 need 应改为 needs（或改用 has to / must / should be improved）。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 主语很长，先找出它的核心名词。
介词短语 of public schools in many rural areas 只是修饰成分，不决定动词的单复数。
核心名词是单数还是复数？动词要随之变化。
explanation: The quality (of public schools in many rural areas) 的核心名词是 quality，单数，所以谓语用 needs：The quality of public schools in many rural areas needs to be improved. 中国学生常被紧挨动词的 areas 或 schools 带偏。

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: One of the main reasons for traffic jams ______ the lack of reliable public transport.
options: are
is
were
be
option_explanations: 错误：主语核心是 One，不是 reasons。
正确：One of the + 复数名词 作主语，谓语用单数 is。
错误：主语是单数；而且句子陈述现状，应用一般现在时。
错误：be 是动词原形，不能直接作谓语。
hints: 这句话的主语从哪个词开始？核心词是什么？
one of the + 复数名词 中，名词用复数，但真正的主语是 one。
核心主语是单数还是复数？句子陈述的是现状还是过去？
explanation: One of the main reasons… 的主语核心是 One，所以谓语用单数：One of the main reasons for traffic jams is the lack of reliable public transport. 注意：reasons 必须用复数，动词却用单数。

instruction: 下面的句子有一处主谓一致错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Reducing the use of plastic bags help protect marine life.
accepted: Reducing the use of plastic bags helps protect marine life.
Reducing the use of plastic bags helps to protect marine life.
Reducing the use of plastic bags can help protect marine life.
Reducing the use of plastic bags can help to protect marine life.
Reducing the use of plastic bags will help protect marine life.
criteria: 动名词短语 Reducing the use of plastic bags 作主语，视为单数，谓语 help 应改为 helps（或用 can/will help）。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 这句话的主语是什么形式？是名词还是动名词短语？
动名词短语作主语时，不论里面有多少复数名词，都当作单数。
不要被 bags 带偏，看动词是否需要第三人称单数形式。
explanation: Reducing the use of plastic bags 是动名词短语作主语，表示“一件事”，谓语用单数：Reducing the use of plastic bags helps protect marine life. bags 只是短语内部的成分，不影响谓语。

instruction: 选出主谓一致完全正确的一项。
options: There is a number of reasons why people choose to live in the countryside.
There are a number of reasons why people chooses to live in the countryside.
There is a number of reasons why people chooses to live in the countryside.
There are a number of reasons why people choose to live in the countryside.
option_explanations: 错误：a number of reasons 意为“许多理由”，是复数，there be 应该用 are。
错误：There are 正确，但 people 是复数，从句谓语应为 choose。
错误：两处都错：is 应为 are，chooses 应为 choose。
正确：There are 与复数的 a number of reasons 一致；people 是复数，后接 choose。
hints: 这道题有两个地方要检查：there be 的形式和从句里的动词。
there be 的单复数由后面的名词决定；a number of + 复数名词 表示“许多”。people 本身就是复数。
分别判断 a number of reasons 和 people 是单数还是复数，再看哪个选项两处都对。
explanation: there be 句型中的 be 与后面的名词一致。a number of reasons = many reasons，是复数，所以用 There are。people 不加 s 却表示复数，从句谓语用 choose。正确：There are a number of reasons why people choose to live in the countryside.

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: The mayor, as well as many local charities, ______ working to reduce homelessness.
options: is
are
have
were
option_explanations: 正确：A as well as B 作主语时，谓语与 A（The mayor）一致，用单数 is。
错误：as well as many local charities 是附加成分，不会把主语变成复数；这与 A and B 不同。
错误：have working 结构错误，进行时需要 be 动词。
错误：主语是单数；而且句子描述当前情况，应用现在进行时。
hints: 用逗号隔开的 as well as 短语是不是主语的核心部分？
A as well as B、A together with B、A along with B 作主语时，动词和 A 一致。
暂时删掉两个逗号之间的内容，再判断主语的单复数。
explanation: as well as、together with、along with 引导的短语只是附加信息，谓语与前面的主语一致。The mayor 是单数，所以：The mayor, as well as many local charities, is working to reduce homelessness. 如果写成 The mayor and many local charities…，主语才是复数，用 are。

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Governments should ______ more money in public transport.
options: invests
to invest
investing
invest
option_explanations: 错误：情态动词后不能用第三人称单数形式。
错误：should 后直接接动词原形，不加 to（ought to 才带 to）。
错误：情态动词后不能接 -ing 形式。
正确：情态动词 should + 动词原形 invest。
hints: 空格前面是什么词？
情态动词 should 后面的动词要用什么形式？
想一想：should 后面能不能带 to？能不能加 -s 或 -ing？
explanation: 情态动词（can, should, must, may, will 等）后一律接动词原形：Governments should invest more money in public transport. 常见错误有 should to invest、should invests。

instruction: 下面的句子有一处动词形式错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Smoking should banned in all public places.
accepted: Smoking should be banned in all public places.
Smoking ought to be banned in all public places.
criteria: 吸烟是“被禁止”的对象，应使用被动语态；情态动词后的被动形式为 be + 过去分词，必须补上 be：should be banned。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受（如 should be prohibited）。
hints: smoking 是去禁止别的东西，还是被禁止？
被动语态的结构是 be + 过去分词，在情态动词后面也一样。
should 和 banned 之间少了一个词。
explanation: Smoking 是被禁止的对象，要用被动语态。情态动词后的被动结构是“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”：Smoking should be banned in all public places. 漏掉 be 是中国学生非常常见的错误。

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Since 2015, the number of electric cars on the road ______ dramatically.
options: increased
is increased
has increased
increases
option_explanations: 错误：since + 过去时间点表示“从那时到现在”，应用现在完成时，而不是一般过去时。
错误：increase 在这里是不及物动词（数量增加），不用被动。
正确：since 引出的时间段延续到现在，用现在完成时；主语 the number 为单数，用 has。
错误：一般现在时不能表达“自 2015 年以来”的变化过程。
hints: 注意句首的时间状语。
since + 过去时间点 表示从过去一直延续到现在，需要哪种时态？
同时注意主语的核心词是单数，以及 increase 在这里是主动还是被动。
explanation: since 2015 表示从 2015 年持续到现在，要用现在完成时；the number of… 作主语为单数，所以用 has increased：Since 2015, the number of electric cars on the road has increased dramatically. increase 表示“增加”时是不及物动词，不用被动。

instruction: 下面的句子有一处动词形式错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Many traffic accidents are happened because drivers use their phones while driving.
accepted: Many traffic accidents happen because drivers use their phones while driving.
Many traffic accidents occur because drivers use their phones while driving.
criteria: happen 是不及物动词，没有被动语态，必须把 are happened 改为 happen（或 occur）。句子陈述普遍现象，应使用一般现在时。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 检查主句的谓语 are happened。
happen、occur、take place 是不及物动词，不能用于被动语态。
陈述普遍现象，用一般现在时的主动形式即可。
explanation: happen 是不及物动词，“发生”不需要被谁做，所以没有被动语态。正确：Many traffic accidents happen because drivers use their phones while driving. 同类词还有 occur、take place、appear、emerge。

instruction: 选出时态和动词形式都正确的一项。
options: Studies show that regular exercise reduces stress, so schools should give students more time for sport.
Studies showed that regular exercise reduced stress, so schools should gave students more time for sport.
Studies show that regular exercise reduce stress, so schools should giving students more time for sport.
Studies show that regular exercise is reduced stress, so schools should give students more time for sport.
option_explanations: 正确：陈述研究结论和普遍事实用一般现在时（show, reduces），情态动词后用原形 give。
错误：should gave 不对，情态动词后必须用原形；此外整句陈述普遍规律，用一般现在时更恰当。
错误：exercise 是单数，应为 reduces；should giving 也不对。
错误：is reduced stress 误用被动，exercise 是主动地“减轻”压力。
hints: 逐个检查每个选项中的三个动词。
议论文陈述普遍事实用一般现在时；情态动词后接原形；主动和被动要分清。
正确选项中，exercise 是“减轻”压力的执行者，should 后面的动词没有任何词尾变化。
explanation: 议论文中引用研究结论、陈述普遍规律，用一般现在时：Studies show that regular exercise reduces stress. 情态动词 should 后接动词原形 give。完整正确句：Studies show that regular exercise reduces stress, so schools should give students more time for sport.

instruction: 下面的句子有一处时态错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: The government has introduced a sugar tax in 2018, and since then sales of soft drinks have fallen.
accepted: The government introduced a sugar tax in 2018, and since then sales of soft drinks have fallen.
The government introduced a sugar tax in 2018, and since then, sales of soft drinks have fallen.
The government introduced a sugar tax in 2018, and sales of soft drinks have fallen since then.
Since the government introduced a sugar tax in 2018, sales of soft drinks have fallen.
criteria: in 2018 是明确的过去时间点，不能与现在完成时连用，必须把 has introduced 改为 introduced；后半句 since then… have fallen 本身正确，应保留现在完成时。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受；删掉 in 2018 来迁就现在完成时属于丢失信息，判错。
hints: 这句话有两个谓语，分别看看它们搭配的时间状语。
现在完成时不能和表示具体过去时间点的状语（如 in 2018、last year）连用。
前半句只需说明那件事发生在过去的哪一年；后半句不用改。
explanation: in 2018 是明确的过去时间，动作发生在过去且已完结，用一般过去时 introduced；since then 表示从那时到现在，用现在完成时 have fallen。正确：The government introduced a sugar tax in 2018, and since then sales of soft drinks have fallen.

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: In recent years, many traditional shops ______ by online retailers.
options: have replaced
have been replaced
were replacing
have been replacing
option_explanations: 错误：have replaced 是主动语态，意思变成“传统商店取代了……”，与 by online retailers 矛盾。
正确：in recent years 用现在完成时；商店是“被取代”，用被动 have been replaced。
错误：过去进行时既不符合 in recent years 的时间关系，又是主动语态。
错误：现在完成进行时的主动形式，同样与 by… 表示的被动意义矛盾。
hints: 注意句首的时间状语和句末的 by online retailers。
in recent years 常与现在完成时连用；by + 动作执行者 提示被动语态。
需要一个同时体现“完成时”和“被动语态”的形式。
explanation: in recent years 表示近年来直到现在的变化，用现在完成时；传统商店是被网店取代，by online retailers 是动作执行者，所以用被动：have been replaced。正确：In recent years, many traditional shops have been replaced by online retailers.

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: If governments had invested in flood defences earlier, much of the damage caused by last year's floods could ______.
options: have prevented
be prevented
been prevented
have been prevented
option_explanations: 错误：have prevented 是主动语态，但 damage 是“被阻止”的对象。
错误：be prevented 指现在或将来，而损失发生在去年，这里是对过去的虚拟。
错误：情态动词 could 后不能直接接过去分词 been。
正确：对过去的虚拟用 could have + 过去分词；damage 是被阻止的，用被动 could have been prevented。
hints: if 从句用了 had invested，说明这是对什么时间的假设？
与过去事实相反的虚拟语气，主句用 could/would + have + 过去分词；还要判断主动还是被动。
damage 自己不会“阻止”什么，它是被阻止的对象；而且去年的事已经发生了。
explanation: if 从句中的 had invested 表示与过去事实相反的假设（第三类条件句），主句用 could have + 过去分词；damage 是被阻止的对象，需要被动，因此是 could have been prevented：If governments had invested in flood defences earlier, much of the damage caused by last year's floods could have been prevented.

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Studying abroad can be ______ valuable experience for ______ university student.
options: a / an
an / a
a / a
the / an
option_explanations: 错误：university 的读音以 /juː/（辅音音素）开头，前面用 a 而不是 an。
错误：valuable 以辅音 /v/ 开头，应用 a。
正确：valuable 和 university 都以辅音音素开头，均用 a；这里泛指“一次经历”“一个大学生”。
错误：这里不是特指某一次经历，不用 the；university 前也不能用 an。
hints: 注意空格后面单词开头的读音，而不是字母。
a / an 的选择由读音决定：辅音音素前用 a，元音音素前用 an。
university 的第一个音和 you 一样。
explanation: a / an 看读音而不是字母：valuable /ˈvæljuəbl/ 和 university /ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːsəti/ 都以辅音音素开头，用 a。正确：Studying abroad can be a valuable experience for a university student. 对比：an hour, an honest person。

instruction: 下面的句子有一处冠词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Every student should have chance to learn a foreign language at school.
accepted: Every student should have a chance to learn a foreign language at school.
Every student should have the chance to learn a foreign language at school.
Every student should have an opportunity to learn a foreign language at school.
Every student should have the opportunity to learn a foreign language at school.
criteria: chance（机会）是可数名词单数，前面不能没有限定词，必须加 a 或 the（换成 an/the opportunity 也可）。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 检查句中每个单数可数名词前面有没有限定词。
chance 表示“机会”时是可数名词，单数时必须有冠词等限定词。
问题出在 have 和 to learn 之间。
explanation: chance（机会）是可数名词，单数时前面必须有限定词：have a chance / have the chance to do sth。正确：Every student should have a chance to learn a foreign language at school. student 和 language 前已经有 every 和 a，没有问题。

instruction: 选出冠词使用完全正确的一项。
options: The pollution is one of the biggest problems facing modern cities.
Pollution is one of biggest problems facing modern cities.
Pollution is one of the biggest problems facing the modern cities.
Pollution is one of the biggest problems facing modern cities.
option_explanations: 错误：pollution 在此泛指“污染”，是不可数抽象名词，不加 the。
错误：形容词最高级前要加 the：one of the biggest problems。
错误：modern cities 泛指所有现代城市，复数泛指不加 the。
正确：泛指的不可数名词用零冠词，最高级前用 the，泛指复数用零冠词。
hints: 这道题有三个位置需要判断：pollution、biggest、modern cities 前面。
泛指的不可数名词和复数名词不加 the；形容词最高级前要加 the。
逐一判断：pollution 和 modern cities 在这里是泛指还是特指？biggest 是什么级，前面需要什么？
explanation: pollution 泛指，不可数，零冠词；最高级 biggest 前必须用 the；modern cities 泛指所有现代城市，复数零冠词。正确：Pollution is one of the biggest problems facing modern cities.

instruction: 下面的句子有一处冠词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: The nature should be protected for future generations.
accepted: Nature should be protected for future generations.
criteria: nature 指“大自然”时是抽象名词泛指，不加 the，必须删掉 The（删除后 Nature 首字母大写）。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 看句首的名词和它前面的冠词。
表示“大自然”的 nature 和 society、history 一样，泛指时不加冠词。
这句话只需要删除，不需要添加。
explanation: nature 表示“大自然”时不加 the（the nature of… 表示“……的本质”才用 the）。正确：Nature should be protected for future generations. 类似的 society、history、education 泛指时也不加 the。

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
