content: A recent study examined the sleep habits of 2,000 teenagers. ______ study found that heavy social media use was linked to poor sleep.
options: A
The
不填（零冠词）
An
option_explanations: 错误：A study 会让读者以为是“另一项研究”，但这里说的就是上一句提到的那项研究。
正确：study 在上一句已经出现过，再次提到同一项研究时读者知道是哪一个，用 the 特指。
错误：study 是可数名词单数，前面必须有限定词，不能用零冠词。
错误：study 以辅音音素开头，即使用不定冠词也应是 a；而且这里是特指。
hints: 注意空格前一句已经出现过的名词。
第一次提到某个可数名词时常用 a/an；读者已经知道指哪一个时，要换一个冠词。另外，可数单数名词前不能没有限定词。
空格处的 study 和上一句的 a recent study 是不是同一项研究？
explanation: 第一次提到“一项研究”时用 a（A recent study…），因为读者还不知道是哪一项；第二次提到同一项研究时，读者已经知道指的是哪一个，要用 the：The study found that heavy social media use was linked to poor sleep. study 是可数名词单数，不能用零冠词。

instruction: 下面的句子有一处冠词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Using a public transport instead of driving can reduce carbon emissions.
accepted: Using public transport instead of driving can reduce carbon emissions.
Using public transportation instead of driving can reduce carbon emissions.
criteria: public transport 是不可数名词，不能加不定冠词 a，必须删除 a（改用美式 public transportation 也可）。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 看 transport 前面的冠词。
public transport 指整个公共交通系统，在英语中通常是不可数名词。
不可数名词前不能用 a/an。
explanation: public transport（美式 public transportation）表示“公共交通”这一系统，是不可数名词，不能加 a。正确：Using public transport instead of driving can reduce carbon emissions. 类似的不可数名词还有 traffic、equipment、information。

instruction: 选出冠词使用完全正确的一项。
options: The unemployment rate among young people has risen in the past year.
Unemployment rate among young people has risen in the past year.
The unemployment rate among the young people has risen in past year.
An unemployment rate among young people has risen in the past year.
option_explanations: 正确：rate 是可数名词单数，被 among young people 限定为特指，用 the；young people 泛指，零冠词；in the past year 中的 the 不能省。
错误：rate 是可数名词单数，前面不能没有限定词。
错误：young people 泛指年轻人，不加 the；in past year 漏了 the。
错误：这里特指“年轻人失业率”这一项具体数据，不能用不定冠词。
hints: 注意 rate、young people 和 past year 前面的冠词。
可数单数名词必须有限定词；被限定、读者知道是哪一个的用 the；泛指复数不用冠词。
“年轻人失业率”是一个特定的统计数据，读者知道指的是哪一个。
explanation: unemployment rate 中的 rate 是可数名词单数，必须有限定词；它被 among young people 限定，是读者明确的那一项数据，用 the。young people 泛指，零冠词。in the past year 中的 the 不能省。正确：The unemployment rate among young people has risen in the past year.

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空（— 表示不填冠词）。
content: In ______ modern world, ______ technology plays a central role in ______ education.
options: — / the / the
a / — / the
the / — / —
the / the / the
option_explanations: 错误：modern world 前需要 the（the modern world 指“当今世界”）；technology 和 education 在此泛指，不加 the。
错误：in a modern world 意为“在某个现代化的世界里”，不符合语境；education 泛指，不加 the。
正确：the modern world 特指“当今世界”；technology 和 education 都是泛指的抽象名词，零冠词。
错误：technology 和 education 在此泛指，加 the 会让读者以为指某种特定的技术或教育。
hints: 三个空分别在 world、technology、education 前面，逐一判断泛指还是特指。
the modern world 指独一无二的“当今世界”；泛指的抽象名词不加冠词。
想一想：technology 和 education 在这里是否指某一种特定的技术、特定的教育？
explanation: the modern world（当今世界）和 the world、the Internet 一样独一无二，用 the；technology 和 education 在这里泛指，抽象名词零冠词。正确：In the modern world, technology plays a central role in education.

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Teachers should give students more ______ on how to manage their time.
options: advices
advice
an advice
advises
option_explanations: 错误：advice 是不可数名词，没有复数形式。
正确：advice 不可数，more advice 表示“更多建议”。
错误：不可数名词前不能用 an，more an advice 的结构也不成立。
错误：advises 是动词 advise 的第三人称单数形式，不是名词。
hints: 空格处需要一个表示“建议”的名词。
advice 是可数名词还是不可数名词？
不可数名词不加 -s，也不和 a/an 连用；还要注意区分名词和动词的拼写。
explanation: advice（建议）是不可数名词，不能加 -s 或 an；表示“一条建议”用 a piece of advice。advise 是动词。正确：Teachers should give students more advice on how to manage their time.

instruction: 下面的句子有一处名词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Students today can find a lot of useful informations online.
accepted: Students today can find a lot of useful information online.
Students today can find lots of useful information online.
Students today can find much useful information online.
criteria: information 是不可数名词，必须去掉 -s。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受（如 plenty of useful information）。
hints: 检查句中每个名词的形式。
information 属于不可数名词。
不可数名词不能加复数词尾。
explanation: information 是不可数名词，没有复数形式；a lot of 可以修饰不可数名词。正确：Students today can find a lot of useful information online. 要计数可以说 a piece of information。

instruction: 选出完全正确的一项（重点注意名词的单复数和可数性）。
options: One of the main reason for obesity is a lack of exercise.
One of the main reasons for obesity are a lack of exercise.
One of the main reasons for obesity is a lack of exercise.
One of the main reasons for obesities is a lack of exercise.
option_explanations: 错误：one of the 后面的名词必须用复数：reasons。
错误：reasons 正确，但主语核心是 One，谓语应为 is。
正确：one of the + 复数名词 + 单数动词；obesity 不可数。
错误：obesity（肥胖）是不可数名词，不加 -s。
hints: 注意 one of the 后面的名词，以及 obesity 的形式。
“……之一”是从多个当中选一个，所以 of 后的名词必须是复数；obesity 是不可数名词。
最后再确认谓语与 One 保持一致。
explanation: one of the + 复数名词 表示“……之一”，名词必须用复数（reasons），但谓语和 one 一致用单数（is）。obesity 是不可数名词，不加 -s。正确：One of the main reasons for obesity is a lack of exercise.

instruction: 下面的句子有一处名词搭配错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Many parents believe that children today receive too many homework.
accepted: Many parents believe that children today receive too much homework.
Many parents believe children today receive too much homework.
Many parents believe that children today receive too many homework assignments.
Many parents believe that children today receive too many assignments.
criteria: homework 是不可数名词，不能用 many 修饰。必须把 too many 改为 too much（或改为 too many homework assignments / too many assignments 等可数表达）。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受；写成 homeworks 判错。
hints: 看 too many 后面的名词。
homework 可数吗？many 和 much 分别修饰什么样的名词？
修饰不可数名词应换用另一个表示“多”的词，而不是给名词加 -s。
explanation: homework 是不可数名词，不能加 -s，也不能用 many 修饰，应该用 much：Many parents believe that children today receive too much homework. 若想用可数名词，可以说 too many assignments。

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: There is not ______ evidence that violent video games make children aggressive.
options: much
many
a few
a number of
option_explanations: 正确：evidence 是不可数名词，否定句中用 much 修饰。
错误：many 只修饰可数名词复数，evidence 不可数。
错误：a few 修饰可数名词复数，而且 There is not a few… 不符合语义。
错误：a number of 修饰可数名词复数，且应搭配 there are。
hints: 先判断 evidence 是可数名词还是不可数名词。
many / a few / a number of 修饰可数名词复数；much / little 修饰不可数名词。
谓语 is 也提示后面的名词是单数或不可数。
explanation: evidence（证据）是不可数名词，不能说 many evidences，否定句中用 much：There is not much evidence that violent video games make children aggressive. 要计数可以用 a piece of evidence。

instruction: 下面的句子有一处名词错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Modern hospitals need expensive equipments and well-trained staff.
accepted: Modern hospitals need expensive equipment and well-trained staff.
Modern hospitals need expensive pieces of equipment and well-trained staff.
criteria: equipment 是不可数名词，必须去掉 -s（或改为 pieces of equipment）。staff 是集体名词，原句用法正确，不需修改；若改成 staffs 判错。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 句中有两个名词 equipments 和 staff，检查它们的形式。
equipment 和 furniture、luggage 一样，是表示一类物品总称的不可数名词。
staff 在这里的用法没有问题。
explanation: equipment（设备）是不可数名词，表示一类东西的总称，不能加 -s；要计数用 a piece of equipment。staff 是集体名词，这里用法正确。正确：Modern hospitals need expensive equipment and well-trained staff.

instruction: 选出名词单复数与可数性都正确的一项。
options: Recent researches have shown that a few minutes of exercise can improve memory.
A recent research has shown that a few minutes of exercise can improve memory.
Recent research has shown that a few minute of exercise can improve memory.
Recent research has shown that a few minutes of exercise can improve memory.
option_explanations: 错误：research 在现代英语中通常是不可数名词，不用复数 researches；可改用 studies。
错误：research 不可数，不能加 a；“一项研究”应为 a study 或 a piece of research。
错误：a few 后接可数名词复数，应为 minutes。
正确：research 不可数，谓语用 has；a few minutes 为复数；exercise 在此表示“锻炼”，不可数。
hints: 注意 research 和 minute 这两个名词。
research 一般作不可数名词；a few 只能修饰可数名词复数。
想表达“一项研究”时，英语常换用另一个可数名词，而不是给 research 加 a 或 -s。
explanation: research 是不可数名词，不说 a research 或 researches，表示“一项研究”可以用 a study。a few 修饰可数复数，所以是 a few minutes。正确：Recent research has shown that a few minutes of exercise can improve memory.

instruction: 选出名词使用完全正确的一项。
options: Rapid urbanisation has brought many opportunities, but it has also created much traffic and many pollution.
Rapid urbanisation has brought many opportunities, but it has also created heavy traffic and serious pollution.
Rapid urbanisation has brought many opportunity, but it has also created heavy traffics and serious pollution.
Rapid urbanisation has brought much opportunities, but it has also created heavy traffic and serious pollutions.
option_explanations: 错误：pollution 是不可数名词，不能用 many 修饰。
正确：opportunities 是可数复数，用 many；traffic 和 pollution 都是不可数名词，不加 -s。
错误：many 后要用复数 opportunities；traffic 不可数，不能加 -s。
错误：much 不能修饰可数复数 opportunities；pollution 不可数，不加 -s。
hints: 每个选项有三个关键名词：opportunity、traffic、pollution，逐一检查。
opportunity 是可数名词；traffic 和 pollution 是不可数名词。
检查 many / much 是否和名词的可数性匹配，以及不可数名词有没有被错误地加上 -s。
explanation: opportunity 可数，多个机会用 many opportunities；traffic 和 pollution 不可数，不加 -s，也不能用 many 修饰。正确：Rapid urbanisation has brought many opportunities, but it has also created heavy traffic and serious pollution.

instruction: 选出标点最规范的一项。
options: In addition students can develop teamwork skills through group projects.
In addition; students can develop teamwork skills through group projects.
In addition, students can develop teamwork skills through group projects.
In addition students, can develop teamwork skills through group projects.
option_explanations: 不规范：句首过渡语 In addition 后应加逗号，与主句隔开。
错误：分号只能连接两个完整句，In addition 不是完整句。
正确：句首过渡语 + 逗号 + 主句。
错误：逗号把主语 students 和谓语 can develop 隔开了。
hints: 注意 In addition 后面的标点。
句首的过渡语（In addition, However, For example 等）后面通常用什么标点？
主语和谓语之间不能插入逗号；分号只用于两个完整句之间。
explanation: In addition、Moreover、For example 等放在句首的过渡语后面要加逗号，与主句隔开：In addition, students can develop teamwork skills through group projects. 分号不能用在短语后面，主语和谓语之间也不能加逗号。

instruction: 下面的句子有一处标点错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Every school should review it's policy on mobile phones.
accepted: Every school should review its policy on mobile phones.
criteria: it's 是 it is / it has 的缩写，这里要表达“它的（学校的）政策”，必须改为不带撇号的物主代词 its。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 检查句中带撇号的词。
it's 是哪两个词的缩写？把它还原后放回句子里读得通吗？
表示“它的”的物主代词和 his、hers 一样，不带撇号。
explanation: it's = it is / it has；its = 它的（物主代词，没有撇号，和 his、hers 一样）。“review it is policy”说不通，所以应为：Every school should review its policy on mobile phones.

instruction: 选择正确的选项填空。
content: Schools should pay more attention to ______ mental health.
options: student's
students'
students
students's
option_explanations: 错误：student's 是单数所有格，单数可数名词前还需要限定词（a student's），而且这里指的是全体学生。
正确：以 s 结尾的复数名词，所有格只加撇号：students'。
错误：缺少撇号，students 只是复数形式，不能表示所属。
错误：以 s 结尾的复数名词不再加 's。
hints: 这里的“学生”是指一个学生，还是全体学生？
复数名词的所有格怎么写，取决于复数形式是否以 s 结尾。
以 s 结尾的复数名词，所有格只需要再加一个符号。
explanation: 这里指全体学生的心理健康，用复数所有格。以 s 结尾的复数名词只加撇号：students' mental health。对比：a student's（单数）、children's（不以 s 结尾的复数）。正确：Schools should pay more attention to students' mental health.

instruction: 下面的句子缺少一个标点，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Although the government has banned plastic bags many shops still use them.
accepted: Although the government has banned plastic bags, many shops still use them.
Many shops still use plastic bags although the government has banned them.
Many shops still use plastic bags, although the government has banned them.
criteria: Although 引导的状语从句位于句首，从句结束处（bags 之后）必须加逗号与主句分开。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受（例如把主句移到前面、从句放在后面，此时 although 前加不加逗号均可）。
hints: 找到从句和主句的分界点。
状语从句放在句首时，后面要用标点与主句隔开。
主句从 many shops 开始，看看它前面缺了什么。
explanation: 句首的状语从句（Although…, If…, When…, Because…）结束后要加逗号，再接主句：Although the government has banned plastic bags, many shops still use them. 如果从句放在主句之后，because / if / when 从句前一般不加逗号，although 从句前加逗号则很常见。

instruction: 选出列举部分标点正确的一项。
options: Living in a big city offers better jobs、more entertainment and better hospitals.
Living in a big city offers better jobs; more entertainment; and better hospitals.
Living in a big city offers, better jobs, more entertainment and better hospitals.
Living in a big city offers better jobs, more entertainment, and better hospitals.
option_explanations: 错误：英文中没有顿号“、”，列举时用逗号。
错误：列举项本身不含逗号时，不用分号分隔。
错误：动词 offers 与宾语之间不能加逗号。
正确：三项列举用逗号分隔；and 前的逗号（牛津逗号）可加可不加，全文保持一致即可。
hints: 注意各个列举项之间的标点。
英文列举一般用逗号分隔；中文顿号在英文中不存在；分号只在列举项内部已有逗号时才用。
还要注意：动词和它的宾语之间不能用逗号隔开。
explanation: 英文列举三项及以上用逗号：A, B, and C 或 A, B and C（牛津逗号可选，全文一致）。中文顿号“、”在英文中不能使用；分号只在列举项本身含有逗号时才使用；动词和宾语之间不加逗号。正确：Living in a big city offers better jobs, more entertainment, and better hospitals.

instruction: 下面的句子有一处标点错误，请改正并写出完整句子。
content: Many young people cannot afford to buy a home; because house prices have risen sharply.
accepted: Many young people cannot afford to buy a home because house prices have risen sharply.
Many young people cannot afford to buy a home, because house prices have risen sharply.
Many young people cannot afford to buy a home; house prices have risen sharply.
Many young people cannot afford to buy a home. House prices have risen sharply.
Because house prices have risen sharply, many young people cannot afford to buy a home.
criteria: 分号两边都必须是完整句，because house prices have risen sharply 是从句，不能单独放在分号后。必须删除分号（直接连接或改用逗号），或删除 because 使后半句成为完整句，或把 because 从句移到句首并加逗号。须保留全部信息。其他改动只要正确、不改变原意均可接受。
hints: 检查分号后面的部分。
分号两边都必须是能独立成句的完整句。
because 引导的是从句，它能和分号搭配吗？
explanation: 分号相当于“弱句号”，两边都必须是完整句。because house prices have risen sharply 是从句，不能独立，因此不能放在分号后。正确：Many young people cannot afford to buy a home because house prices have risen sharply. 也可以去掉 because：…a home; house prices have risen sharply.

instruction: 选出标点完全正确的一项。
options: Renewable energy is becoming cheaper, however, it still cannot meet all of our needs.
Renewable energy is becoming cheaper however; it still cannot meet all of our needs.
Renewable energy is becoming cheaper; however, it still cannot meet all of our needs.
Renewable energy is becoming cheaper; however it still cannot meet all of our needs.
option_explanations: 错误：however 前只用逗号，构成逗号连句。
错误：分号位置不对，应放在 however 之前，因为 however 属于第二个分句。
正确：分号连接两个完整句，however 后加逗号。
错误：however 作连接副词放在分句开头时，后面应加逗号。
hints: 关注 however 前后的两个标点。
however 不是连词：它前面需要一个能分隔完整句的标点，后面需要一个逗号。
however 属于后一个分句的开头，那么分隔两句的标点应放在它的哪一边？
explanation: however 是连接副词，连接两个完整句时的标准格式是“分号 + however + 逗号”：Renewable energy is becoming cheaper; however, it still cannot meet all of our needs. 也可以用句号：…cheaper. However, it still…

instruction: 选出标点完全正确的一项。
options: According to the report, the city's air quality has improved; nevertheless, residents' complaints about noise, traffic and litter have increased.
According to the report the city's air quality has improved; nevertheless, residents complaints about noise, traffic and litter have increased.
According to the report, the citys' air quality has improved, nevertheless, residents' complaints about noise, traffic and litter have increased.
According to the report, the city's air quality has improved; nevertheless residents' complaints about noise; traffic and litter have increased.
option_explanations: 正确：引导语后有逗号；单数所有格 city's；分号 + nevertheless + 逗号；复数所有格 residents'；列举用逗号。
错误：residents 缺少表示所有格的撇号（应为 residents'）；另外 According to the report 后也应加逗号。
错误：city 是单数，所有格应为 city's；nevertheless 前只用逗号，构成逗号连句。
错误：nevertheless 后缺逗号；列举 noise, traffic and litter 中误用了分号。
hints: 这道题同时考查引导语、所有格、连接副词和列举四个标点点，逐一检查。
city 是单数还是复数？residents 呢？nevertheless 的标点规则和 however 相同。
正确选项中，两个撇号一个在 s 之前、一个在 s 之后。
explanation: 本句综合考查四种标点：① 句首引导语 According to the report 后加逗号；② city 是单数，所有格为 city's，residents 是以 s 结尾的复数，所有格为 residents'；③ nevertheless 是连接副词，前面用分号，后面加逗号；④ 列举 noise, traffic and litter 用逗号。正确：According to the report, the city's air quality has improved; nevertheless, residents' complaints about noise, traffic and litter have increased.

instruction: 阅读主题句，选出最能支撑它的一句话。
content: Topic sentence: Regular exercise can improve students' academic performance.
options: Exercise is good for everyone, whether they are young or old, rich or poor.
Many students enjoy playing basketball or football with their friends after school.
Physical activity increases blood flow to the brain, which helps students concentrate better in class.
Academic performance is very important for students' future careers and university applications.
option_explanations: 太笼统：只说运动“对每个人都好”，没有说明它如何影响学习成绩，与主题句的核心（academic performance）没有挂钩。
说的是学生“喜欢”打球，喜欢不等于成绩提高，与论点无关。
正确。给出了具体机制：运动→大脑供血增加→上课更专注，直接解释了运动为什么能提高成绩。
只是强调成绩很重要，并没有说明运动与成绩之间的关系，没有支撑作用。
hints: 先圈出主题句里的两个关键概念：exercise 和 academic performance。
好的支撑必须把这两个概念连起来，说明一个“如何”影响另一个。
排除只谈其中一个概念、或只谈“喜欢/重要”的选项，找那个讲出具体过程的句子。
explanation: 支撑句必须直接回答“为什么运动能提高成绩”。只有“Physical activity increases blood flow to the brain, which helps students concentrate better in class.”给出了从运动到学习效果的具体机制。其他选项要么太笼统，要么只谈其中一个概念，要么与论点无关。

instruction: 下面四句都想支撑同一个主题句。哪一句其实只是换个说法重复观点，并没有提供真正的支撑？
content: Topic sentence: Social media can harm teenagers' mental health.
options: Teenagers who compare themselves with edited photos often feel worse about their own appearance.
Scrolling late at night can cut into teenagers' sleep, and poor sleep is closely linked to anxiety.
Online bullying can follow students home, so they have no safe place to escape from it.
Using social media is bad for the psychological well-being of young people.
option_explanations: 这是真正的支撑：给出了具体机制（与修过的照片比较→对自己的外貌不满）。
这是真正的支撑：说明了深夜刷手机→睡眠不足→焦虑的因果链。
这是真正的支撑：网络霸凌让学生回家后也无处躲避，具体说明了伤害如何发生。
正确答案。“bad for the psychological well-being of young people”只是把“harm teenagers' mental health”换了同义词，没有任何新理由或例子，属于同义反复。
hints: 把每个选项和主题句逐词对照，看哪句只是换了同义词。
真正的支撑会说出“怎样”造成伤害——一个具体情境或因果过程。
找出那句删掉后读者也不会少知道任何新理由的句子。
explanation: 同义反复（circular support）是中国学生最常见的支撑问题之一：bad ≈ harm，psychological well-being ≈ mental health，young people ≈ teenagers。真正的支撑要提供新信息，如具体情境（修图照片、深夜刷屏、网络霸凌）以及它们如何损害心理健康。

instruction: 选择最适合填入空白处的句子，使段落的支撑逻辑完整。
content: Working from home can increase employees' productivity. ________ As a result, many employees finish their tasks faster than they did in the office.
options: Without a daily commute, employees save time and energy, and they face fewer interruptions from colleagues.
However, some employees feel lonely when they work at home for long periods.
Working from home has become popular in many countries since 2020.
Productivity is the key to the success of any company.
option_explanations: 正确。省去通勤、减少同事打扰，正是“完成得更快”的原因，与后面的 As a result 形成清楚的因果链。
这是反方观点（孤独感），与主题句方向相反，也无法引出“因此完成任务更快”。
“流行”不等于“提高效率”，与论点无关，也接不上 As a result。
只是泛泛强调效率重要，没有说明在家办公为什么能提高效率。
hints: 注意空白后面的 As a result——空白处必须是“原因”。
这个原因要能直接导致“完成任务更快”，并且支持主题句的观点。
排除方向相反、以及只说“流行”或“重要”的选项，剩下那句必须说出在家办公具体带来了什么便利。
explanation: 空白处必须为主题句提供具体理由，并能被 As a result 自然承接。“Without a daily commute, employees save time and energy, and they face fewer interruptions from colleagues.”说明了效率提高的具体原因，因此后句“finish their tasks faster”顺理成章。

instruction: 哪一个例子最具体、最直接地支撑了主题句？
content: Topic sentence: Charging customers for plastic bags can sharply reduce their use.
options: Some countries have started charging customers for plastic bags, and the results have been very good so far.
After Ireland introduced a charge on plastic bags in 2002, their use fell by more than 90 percent within a short time.
Plastic bags are harmful to the environment because they can take hundreds of years to break down.
I believe most people would quickly stop using plastic bags if they had to pay for every one.
option_explanations: 方向对，但太空泛：哪些国家？“results have been very good”具体指什么？读者无法核实。
正确。有具体国家、时间和可衡量的结果，直接证明“收费→使用量大幅下降”。
这句说明塑料袋有害，支撑的是“为什么要减少塑料袋”，而不是“收费能减少使用”。
只是作者的个人猜测（I believe… would…），不是证据。
hints: 主题句的核心是：“收费”能否“大幅减少使用”。
好的例子要具体（谁、何时、结果如何），而且证明的正是这个论点，而不是相邻话题。
排除空泛的、只是个人猜测的、或证明的是另一个论点的选项。
explanation: 具体例子应包含可核实的细节，并且证明的正是论点本身。爱尔兰 2002 年开始对塑料袋收费后，使用量在短期内下降了九成以上，直接证明收费的效果。讲塑料袋有害的句子虽然正确，但支撑的是另一个论点。

instruction: 为下面的主题句写 2 句支撑句：第一句给出理由（解释为什么），第二句给出一个具体例子。
content: Topic sentence: Learning a foreign language at a young age has clear advantages.
accepted: Young children can imitate new sounds more easily than adults, so they are more likely to develop natural pronunciation. For example, a child who starts learning English at six in a bilingual primary school often speaks with a near-native accent by the age of twelve, whereas many adult learners keep a strong accent for life.

Because young learners are less afraid of making mistakes, they are more willing to speak and practise. In my primary school, for instance, pupils happily sang English songs and played speaking games in class, while many older students I later met in secondary school were too shy to answer questions aloud.
criteria: 通过条件：①用英文写 2 句左右（2-3 句均可）；②至少一句说明原因或机制，且必须与“年龄小”相关（如更容易模仿发音、更不怕犯错、积累时间更长、更容易习得自然语感等），不能只说“学外语有好处”；③至少一个具体例子（具体的人、情境、学校项目或可想象的结果），且例子与“从小学习”的优势直接相关；④不能只是同义重复主题句；⑤语法基本正确，个别不影响理解的小错误可接受。不要求真实数据，但不应编造过分精确的统计数字。
hints: 主题句的关键词是“at a young age”——你的理由必须说明为什么“年龄小”是优势。
第一句写机制（because / so），第二句用 For example / For instance 引出一个具体的人或场景。
想一想小孩和成人学外语时在发音或心理上有什么不同，再把这种不同变成一个读者能想象的画面。
explanation: 合格的支撑包括“理由+例子”：理由解释“为什么年龄小有优势”（如更易模仿发音、更不怕犯错），例子让理由变得具体可信。常见问题是只写“Learning a language is useful”，忽略了主题句中的关键限定“at a young age”。

instruction: 阅读段落，找出与本段中心无关、应该删除的那一句。
content: (1) Public libraries remain valuable in the digital age. (2) They offer free internet access to people who cannot afford a computer at home. (3) Many libraries also run workshops that teach older residents how to use smartphones and online banking. (4) Some famous libraries, such as the British Library, are known for their impressive architecture. (5) In this way, libraries help to close the digital divide rather than being replaced by technology.
options: Sentence (2)
Sentence (3)
Sentence (4)
Sentence (5)
option_explanations: 第(2)句说明图书馆为没有电脑的人提供免费上网，直接支撑“在数字时代仍有价值”，不能删。
第(3)句说明图书馆教老年人使用智能手机和网银，是缩小数字鸿沟的具体例子，不能删。
正确。第(4)句讲建筑之美，虽然也是图书馆的优点，但与本段“数字时代/缩小数字鸿沟”的中心无关，应删除。
第(5)句是总结句，把前面的例子回扣到“缩小数字鸿沟”，不能删。
hints: 先看第(5)句的总结，确认本段真正的中心是什么。
相关性不只是“说图书馆好”，而是“说明图书馆在数字时代为什么有价值”。
找出那句即使属实、也与技术和数字鸿沟毫无关系的句子。
explanation: 支撑句必须服务于本段的具体论点，而不是泛泛地说“图书馆好”。本段论证的是图书馆在数字时代的价值（免费上网、数字技能培训→缩小数字鸿沟）。第(4)句关于建筑的内容偏离了这一中心，破坏了段落的统一性。

instruction: 对于下面的论点，哪一条支撑最有力？
content: Claim: Raising the price of cigarettes is an effective way to reduce smoking among young people.
options: My uncle stopped smoking last year when cigarettes became too expensive for him.
Smoking is one of the leading causes of preventable death in the world, killing millions of people every year.
Everyone knows that young people do not have much money, so they cannot afford expensive things.
Research in many countries has found that young people are especially sensitive to price, so tax increases tend to reduce smoking more among teenagers than among adults.
option_explanations: 个人经历，而且叔叔是成年人，不能证明“年轻人”会因涨价而少抽烟。
事实正确，但它说明的是吸烟的危害，而不是“涨价能减少年轻人吸烟”。
“Everyone knows”是常识性断言，缺乏证据；而且“钱少”与“少抽烟”之间的联系并没有被证明。
正确。来自多国研究的发现，直接针对“价格→年轻人吸烟减少”这一关系，具体且相关。
hints: 论点有两个关键点：“涨价”和“年轻人”。
比较各选项：哪些只是个人经历、常识断言，或与论点相邻但不同的事实？
最有力的支撑要同时覆盖这两个关键点，而且来源不只是一个人。
explanation: 有力的支撑必须相关（针对涨价对年轻人的影响）且有分量（多国研究，而不是一个人）。叔叔的经历是个例且对象是成年人；吸烟致死的事实与价格无关；“Everyone knows”只是断言。只有多国研究的发现直接证明了论点。

instruction: 下面段落的支撑部分空洞无力。请保留第一句主题句，重写后面的支撑部分（共 3-4 句），要求包含至少一个具体例子、至少一处解释性推理，并以一句回扣主题的总结句结尾。
content: Cities should give priority to cyclists. Cycling is good. Many people like it, and it has many advantages. So cities should do it.
accepted: Cities should give priority to cyclists. When safe, separated bike lanes are built, more residents choose to cycle for short trips, which takes cars off crowded roads. Copenhagen is a clear example: after decades of investment in cycling infrastructure, a large share of its residents now ride to work or school. Fewer car journeys also mean cleaner air and fitter citizens, which reduces pressure on public health services. Giving cyclists priority is therefore not a favour to a small group but an investment in the whole city.

Cities should give priority to cyclists. A bicycle takes up only a fraction of the road space that a car needs, so a lane full of cyclists can move far more people than a lane full of cars. In Paris, for example, the city has created hundreds of kilometres of new cycle lanes in recent years, and the number of people cycling has risen sharply. As more residents switch from cars to bikes, traffic noise and air pollution fall as well. Prioritising cyclists is therefore one of the cheapest ways to make a city cleaner and easier to move around.
criteria: 通过条件：①保留主题句“Cities should give priority to cyclists.”（或意思相同的表达）；②支撑部分 3-4 句，总长度约 50-110 词；③至少一个具体、相关的例子（具体城市、具体措施、具体情境或数据），且与“优先照顾骑行者”直接相关；④至少一处推理，说明给骑行者优先权如何带来好处（如减少拥堵、改善空气、提升健康、节省道路空间等），并使用 because / which means / so / as a result 等信号；⑤最后一句回扣主题，而不是简单重复主题句；⑥不得保留“Cycling is good”“many advantages”之类空泛句；⑦语法基本正确。真实城市的例子不得明显违背事实。
hints: 原段落的问题在于“good”“many advantages”都没有说清楚是什么好处。
先选一个具体好处（拥堵、空气、健康或空间），用 because / which means 解释机制，再用 For example 引出一个具体城市或场景。
最后一句不要原样重复主题句，试着说明这种优先权对整个城市意味着什么。
explanation: 原段落的支撑全是空泛评价（good, many advantages），没有任何具体内容。好的支撑应包括：具体例子（如哥本哈根、巴黎的自行车道建设）、推理（自行车占用空间少→减少拥堵和污染→改善健康）以及回扣主题的总结句。

instruction: 下面这句话属于哪一类论据？
content: When I was in high school, I joined the debate club, and it made me much more confident when speaking in public.
options: A statistic
A personal experience
A hypothetical situation
An expert opinion
option_explanations: 句中没有任何数字或调查数据，不是统计数据。
正确。这是作者自己（I）的亲身经历：参加辩论社后变得更自信。
假设通常用 If… would… 或 Imagine… 描述没有发生的情况；这件事已经真实发生过。
没有引用任何专家或机构的观点。
hints: 注意句子的主语和时态：是谁的事？发生过没有？
四类材料：数据、个人经历、假设、专家观点——它们各有标志词。
句中的 I 和过去时 was / joined 提示了这条论据的来源。
explanation: 这是个人经历（personal experience）：主语是 I，讲述过去真实发生的事。个人经历生动，但只代表一个人，不能单独证明“参加辩论社能让所有学生更自信”这样的普遍结论，最好与更广泛的证据搭配使用。

instruction: 要支撑下面的论点，哪一条论据最可靠？
content: Claim: Most teenagers today spend too much time on their phones.
options: My younger brother is fifteen, and he uses his phone for about six hours every day.
If teenagers did not have phones, they would read many more books and spend more time outdoors.
A national survey of thousands of teenagers found that the majority used their phones for more than four hours a day outside school.
Teenagers love their phones because phones are very interesting and full of entertaining content.
option_explanations: 只是一个人的情况，不能证明“大多数”青少年。
这是假设（If… would…），讲的是没有手机会怎样，并没有证明他们现在用得多。
正确。全国性、大样本的调查，且直接测量使用时长，能支撑“大多数青少年”这一普遍结论。
这只是观点，近乎循环论证，没有任何事实或数据。
hints: 注意论点中的“Most”——它需要多大范围的证据？
个例、假设和观点都无法证明“大多数人”的情况。
寻找样本大、并且直接测量了“使用时长”的那条论据。
explanation: 论点越普遍（most），需要的证据范围就越大。弟弟一个人的情况是孤例；If… would… 是假设；“because phones are very interesting”只是观点。大样本的全国调查才足以支撑“大多数青少年”的说法。

instruction: 阅读下面的段落，判断其论据最主要的问题是什么。
content: A university degree is no longer necessary for success. Bill Gates left Harvard and went on to found Microsoft, one of the most valuable companies in the world. Mark Zuckerberg created Facebook as a student and then left university to run it. Steve Jobs spent only a short time at college before he founded Apple. These cases clearly prove that young people do not need to spend four years at university. Instead, they should start working or running their own businesses as early as possible.
options: The examples are famous exceptions, so they cannot show what is true for most people.
The examples are not related to the topic of university education.
The paragraph does not contain any examples.
The examples are too old to be used in an essay.
option_explanations: 正确。盖茨等人是极少数的特例（幸存者偏差）：无数辍学后并不成功的人不会出名。几个名人不能证明“大多数年轻人”不需要上大学。
例子都与“上不上大学”有关，并没有跑题。
段落有三个具体例子，问题不在于没有例子。
例子是否“旧”不是关键；即使是最新的名人例子，也同样无法代表大多数人。
hints: 依次检查：例子与话题相关吗？数量够吗？它们代表的是什么样的人？
想一想：我们为什么只听说过辍学后成功的人？
关注这些例子与“young people”这个普遍群体之间的关系。
explanation: 这段论据的问题在于代表性：盖茨、扎克伯格、乔布斯都是极其罕见的成功者，属于“幸存者偏差”。要支撑关于大多数人的结论，需要更广泛的证据，比如不同学历人群的平均收入和就业率。

instruction: 对于下面的论点，哪一条论据最相关？
content: Claim: Schools should provide free healthy lunches because such meals help students concentrate in class.
options: Many parents are too busy in the morning to cook a healthy breakfast for their children.
Healthy school lunches cost much less per meal than food bought in restaurants or cafés.
Childhood obesity has risen in many countries over the past thirty years, partly because of poor diets.
After several schools in a trial began serving balanced lunches, teachers reported that pupils were more attentive in afternoon lessons.
option_explanations: 讲的是早餐和父母忙碌，与“学校午餐”和“专注力”都不直接相关。
讲的是成本，可以支持“供餐可行”，但不能证明午餐能提高专注力。
讲的是肥胖问题，属于健康话题，与本论点的理由“专注力”不同。
正确。直接把“提供均衡午餐”与“下午课堂更专注”联系起来，紧扣论点的理由。
hints: 注意论点中 because 之后的理由——它才是需要被证明的部分。
相关的论据必须同时涉及“学校午餐”和“专注力”。
讲早餐、成本或肥胖的选项即使本身正确，它们证明的是“专注力”吗？
explanation: 论据的相关性要看它证明的是不是论点中“这个”理由。本题的理由是“午餐能提高专注力”，只有试点学校教师的观察直接涉及这一关系。成本和肥胖虽然与学校午餐话题相邻，但支撑的是其他论点。

instruction: 阅读下面的段落，判断其论据最主要的问题。
content: Video games have a negative effect on children's school performance. Studies show that children who play video games get lower grades. Experts also say that games can damage the brain. In fact, 87.3% of young gamers fail at least one exam every year. Therefore, parents should not allow their children to play video games at all, because the evidence is very clear.
options: The paragraph relies too much on the writer's personal experience and the experiences of friends.
The sources are vague and cannot be checked ('studies show', 'experts say'), and the very precise statistic has no source, so the evidence is not credible.
The evidence is strong and varied, but the paragraph needs a clearer topic sentence at the beginning.
The evidence is credible, but the conclusion is too weak, so the writer should state it more forcefully.
option_explanations: 段落中没有任何个人经历（没有 I / my / my friend）。
正确。“Studies show”“Experts say”没有说明是什么研究、谁说的；87.3% 这样精确的数字却没有出处，很像编造的。论据缺乏可信度。
第一句已经是清楚的主题句，问题不在这里；而且论据也并不“strong”。
结论“at all”不是太弱而是过于绝对；而且论据本身并不可信。
hints: 问问自己：读者能查到这些研究和专家是谁吗？
可信的论据需要清楚的来源；过分精确却没有出处的数字反而让人起疑。
关注 'Studies show'、'Experts say' 和那个带小数点的百分比。
explanation: 这段的论据看起来很多，但都不可信：模糊的来源（studies show, experts say）无法核实，87.3% 的精确数字没有出处，很可能是编造的。考官会认为这种“伪证据”比没有证据更糟。更好的做法是说明研究的大致来源和发现，或使用合理的具体例子，并把结论写得更有分寸。

instruction: 根据下面的证据，哪一个结论写得最恰当（论据的分量与结论的强度相匹配）？
content: Evidence: In a survey of 200 students at one university in Beijing, 70 percent said they preferred online lectures to face-to-face lectures.
options: Most university students around the world now prefer online lectures to face-to-face ones.
Online lectures are clearly more effective than face-to-face teaching at university.
Most of the students surveyed at this university preferred online lectures, but similar surveys elsewhere would be needed before drawing wider conclusions.
Chinese universities should replace all of their face-to-face lectures with online ones.
option_explanations: 过度概括：一所大学的 200 人不能代表“全世界”的大学生。
偷换概念：调查测的是“喜欢”，不是“效果”；学生喜欢不等于学得更好。
正确。结论只限于被调查的这所大学的学生，并指出要推广到其他地方还需要更多调查，论据分量与结论强度相匹配。
从一所学校的偏好直接跳到全国政策，并且用了 all，远远超出证据能支撑的范围。
hints: 先看证据的范围：多少人？在哪里？测量的是什么？
结论不能超出证据的范围，也不能把“喜欢”换成“有效”。
寻找那个只在证据范围内下结论、并承认还需要更多证据的选项。
explanation: 论据质量还包括“够不够支撑这个结论”。一所大学 200 名学生的偏好，只能支持一个有限定的结论：只谈被调查的学生，并承认需要更多调查才能推广。过度概括（全世界）、偷换概念（偏好→效果）和跳到绝对化政策（all）都会让考官质疑论证。

instruction: 阅读下面的段落，判断其论据最主要的问题。
content: Banning cars from city centres would make people much happier. Imagine walking down a quiet street with no traffic noise, where children can play safely and the air smells fresh. Everyone would feel relaxed and would spend more time chatting with their neighbours. Local shops would be full of customers, because people could stroll from one store to another. Clearly, a car-free centre is the best choice for every modern city.
options: The paragraph is off-topic, because it moves from traffic to shops and neighbours instead of discussing cars.
The paragraph relies on a single personal story about what happened in the writer's own city.
The paragraph uses too many statistics, which makes the argument difficult for readers to follow.
The whole argument rests on an imagined scene; it gives no real cases or data showing that car-free centres actually make people happier.
option_explanations: 安静的街道、邻里交流和商店顾客增多都是作者设想的“无车”好处，与话题相关，并没有跑题。
段落中没有作者自己的经历，全部是 Imagine… would… 的想象。
段落中没有任何统计数据。
正确。Imagine 和一连串 would 说明这只是假设场景；作者没有提供任何真实城市的案例或数据，却得出“Clearly… the best choice for every modern city”的强结论。
hints: 注意段落中的动词形式：is / was 还是 would？
假设（Imagine… would…）可以帮助读者想象，但不能证明事情真的会发生。
问问自己：段落中有没有提到任何一个真实存在的城市或调查结果？
explanation: 假设场景可以让文章生动，但它只是作者的想象，不能作为主要证据。这段从头到尾都是 would，却得出“对每个现代城市都是最佳选择”的绝对结论。更好的做法是引用真实案例，例如某城市限制汽车进入市中心后空气质量、行人满意度或商铺营业额的变化。

instruction: 阅读下面的段落，判断其论据最主要的问题。
content: Remote work is better for the environment than working in an office. According to a large survey by a well-known consulting firm, more than 60 percent of remote employees said they felt more productive at home. Another study found that people who work from home report lower stress levels and spend more time with their families. These findings show that companies should encourage remote work in order to protect the planet.
options: The evidence comes from credible-sounding surveys, but it is about productivity and well-being, not the environment, so it does not prove the claim.
The sources cannot be trusted, because consulting firms are always biased in favour of their clients.
The paragraph needs more personal stories, because readers find individual experiences more convincing.
The evidence is sufficient and relevant; the only problem is that the conclusion is too long.
option_explanations: 正确。调查看起来可信，但讲的是效率、压力和家庭时间，与“对环境更好”无关。论据再可信，不相关也证明不了论点。
“always biased”本身就是过度概括；而且即使来源完全可信，这段的根本问题仍是论据与论点不相关。
增加个人故事并不能解决“论据与论点不相关”的问题，反而会降低论据的分量。
论据并不充分也不相关，因为它们根本没有涉及环境；问题不在结论长短。
hints: 先找出论点的核心词：作者要证明的“好处”到底是哪一方面的？
可信不等于相关：检查每条数据实际测量的是什么。
比较主题句里的 environment / planet 和两项调查的内容。
explanation: 这是较隐蔽的论据问题：数据来源听起来可信，但证明的是相邻的论点（远程办公提高效率、改善生活），而不是“对环境更好”。要支撑原论点，应使用减少通勤排放、办公楼能耗等相关证据，并考虑居家能耗增加等反面因素。

instruction: 选出最适合跟在论据后面的分析句。
content:
Topic sentence: Reading for pleasure improves students' writing.
Evidence: Students who read novels regularly are exposed to thousands of well-written sentences.
options: Reading novels is a popular hobby, and many teenagers especially enjoy fantasy stories.
As a result, they gradually absorb vocabulary and sentence patterns that they can later use in their own writing.
Therefore, every student should be forced to read one novel a week.
This shows that students who read novels regularly read many sentences.
option_explanations: 讲阅读很流行、青少年喜欢什么类型，与“为什么阅读能改善写作”无关。
正确。解释了机制：大量接触好句子→吸收词汇和句型→运用到自己的写作中，把论据和论点连了起来。
直接跳到建议（而且 forced、every 过于绝对），没有解释论据为什么能证明论点。
只是把论据换个说法重复，没有提供“所以呢”的新信息。
hints: 分析句要回答：读了很多好句子，为什么写作就会变好？
好的分析说明“过程”，而不是重复论据或直接提建议。
找出把“读到的句子”与“自己的写作”联系起来的那一句。
explanation: 分析（warrant）是论据和论点之间的桥梁。论据只说“学生读到很多好句子”，分析要说明这如何改善写作：吸收词汇和句型，再用到自己的文章里。重复论据或直接提建议都跳过了这一步。

instruction: 阅读段落，哪一句承担了“分析”的作用，即解释论据为什么能支撑论点？
content: (1) Public transport should be free for students. (2) In Tallinn, the capital of Estonia, public transport has been free for registered residents since 2013. (3) This shows that removing fares can make buses and trams accessible to people who would otherwise struggle with the cost, which matters especially for students on tight budgets. (4) Other cities should therefore consider following this example.
options: Sentence (1)
Sentence (2)
Sentence (3)
Sentence (4)
option_explanations: 第(1)句是主题句，提出论点。
第(2)句是论据（塔林的事实），本身没有解释它意味着什么。
正确。第(3)句用 This shows that… which matters… 说明塔林的例子为什么与“学生免费乘车”相关。
第(4)句是结论/建议，出现在分析之后。
hints: 先给每句贴标签：观点、论据、分析、结论。
分析句常用 This shows / This means / which… 等信号。
找出那句把塔林的事实和“学生”联系起来的句子。
explanation: 典型的论证段落结构是：论点（1）→ 论据（2）→ 分析（3）→ 结论（4）。第(3)句解释了取消票价如何帮助经济困难的人，并特别联系到学生，这正是分析的作用。

instruction: 选出对这条论据分析得最好的一句。
content:
Topic sentence: Replacing roads with green spaces can improve city life.
Evidence: When Seoul replaced an elevated highway with the restored Cheonggyecheon stream in 2005, the area became one of the city's most popular public spaces.
options: This shows that Seoul has a stream called Cheonggyecheon, which runs through the city centre.
This proves that every city should immediately destroy all of its highways and replace them with parks.
Seoul is the capital of South Korea and has a population of nearly ten million people.
This suggests that when space is given back to people rather than cars, residents gain a place to relax and meet, which can make crowded city centres more pleasant to live in.
option_explanations: 只是重复论据中的事实，没有解释它为什么支持论点。
过度推论：一个城市的成功不能推出“每个城市都应立刻拆掉所有高速路”。
背景信息，与论证无关，没有任何分析作用。
正确。说明了机制（空间从汽车还给人→居民有地方休闲交往→市中心更宜居），并回扣“改善城市生活”，语气也有分寸。
hints: 分析要说明首尔的例子“意味着什么”，而不是重复事实或补充背景。
注意避免两种错误：只复述事实，以及从一个例子推出过于绝对的结论。
找出那个解释“绿地如何改善居民生活”的句子，留意它用的限定词。
explanation: 好的分析会提炼例子背后的机制并回扣论点，同时保持分寸（suggests, can）。复述事实、补充无关背景或推出“every city… all”的绝对结论都不是有效分析。

instruction: 下面的论据和论点之间缺少一个推理环节（warrant）。哪一句最能把两者连接起来？
content:
Claim: Schools should teach financial literacy.
Evidence: Many young adults get into credit card debt soon after leaving school.
options: Many young adults fall into debt because they were never taught how interest and borrowing work, and school is the one place where everyone could learn this before facing real financial decisions.
Credit cards were first introduced in the twentieth century and have become more popular ever since.
Some young adults have part-time jobs while they are studying, so they already earn some money of their own.
Banks earn large profits from the interest that customers pay on credit cards, especially when payments are late.
option_explanations: 正确。指出负债的原因是缺乏金融知识，并说明学校是弥补这一缺口的合适场所，把论据与“学校应该教”连接了起来。
历史背景，与论证无关。
兼职收入与负债、与学校课程都没有逻辑联系。
说明银行获利，与话题相关，但没有解释为什么“学校”应该承担这项教学责任。
hints: 论据讲“年轻人负债”，论点讲“学校应该教”——中间缺什么？
推理环节需要说明：负债的原因是什么？为什么这个原因应由学校来解决？
找出同时提到“原因”和“学校的角色”的那一句。
explanation: warrant 回答“为什么这个论据能证明这个论点”。年轻人负债本身并不能直接推出“学校应该教金融知识”，除非说明：负债源于缺乏相关知识，而学校是人人都能在做真实财务决定之前学习这些知识的地方。

instruction: 阅读主题句和论据，写 1-2 句分析，解释这条论据为什么能支撑主题句。请使用 This shows / This means / because / As a result 等分析信号。
content:
Topic sentence: Online learning can widen the gap between rich and poor students.
Evidence: During school closures in 2020, many children from low-income families had no laptop or stable internet connection at home.
accepted: This meant that they often missed live lessons or had to follow them on a parent's phone, while wealthier classmates studied without interruption. As a result, the difference in what the two groups learned grew larger, which shows how online learning can turn an economic gap into an educational one.

This shows that online learning depends on resources that not every family can afford: children without devices fell behind in their studies, while those with good equipment kept learning, so the gap between them grew.
criteria: 通过条件：①1-2 句英文；②必须说明机制：没有电脑/网络→无法正常上课或学习受影响（如错过直播课、只能用家长手机、作业无法提交等）；③必须回扣“差距扩大”，即与富裕家庭学生的对比或学习成果差距；④至少使用一个分析信号（This shows / This means / because / As a result / which means 等）；⑤不能只重复论据，也不能引入无关的新论点；⑥语法基本正确。
hints: 论据讲“没有设备”，主题句讲“差距扩大”——你的分析要把这两点连起来。
先写“没有设备导致了什么”，再写“和富裕家庭的孩子相比结果如何”。
试着用 This meant that… 开头，再用 As a result / which shows… 回扣主题句。
explanation: 有效的分析要讲清因果链：缺少设备→错过课程、学习中断→与有条件的同学拉开差距→线上学习扩大了贫富学生之间的差距。只写“This shows that poor students had no laptops”属于重复论据，没有分析。

instruction: 选出对这条论据分析得最好的一句。
content:
Topic sentence: Mass tourism can damage local culture.
Evidence: In some popular old towns, traditional family-run shops have been replaced by souvenir stores selling the same mass-produced goods.
options: This indicates that when businesses serve mainly visitors, the crafts and daily routines that made a town distinctive can disappear, leaving a place that looks traditional but no longer functions as a living community.
This shows that souvenir stores are very profitable in tourist areas, so more of them will open in the future.
This means that tourists should stop buying souvenirs, because most souvenirs are a waste of money.
This proves that tourism destroys every culture it comes into contact with.
option_explanations: 正确。解释了“店铺被替换”如何导致“文化受损”：服务对象变成游客→传统手艺和日常生活消失→古镇只剩外壳。紧扣论点，并用 can 保持分寸。
转移了焦点：讲的是盈利和店铺数量，而不是文化受损，没有回扣论点。
跳到一个理由不同的新建议（纪念品浪费钱），偏离了“文化”这一核心。
过度概括（every culture），一个现象不能证明旅游摧毁所有文化。
hints: 分析必须回扣主题句的核心词“local culture”。
警惕三种陷阱：转移到另一话题、跳到新建议、用 every / all 过度概括。
找出那句解释“店铺被替换”如何让古镇失去原有生活和特色的句子。
explanation: 高质量分析要做到：①解释机制（为什么店铺变化意味着文化受损）；②回扣论点关键词；③语气有分寸。讲盈利、谈纪念品浪费或推出“每一种文化”都偏离了论证。

instruction: 阅读段落，选出最能提升这一段的修改建议。
content: Advertising aimed at young children should be restricted. Research suggests that children under about eight years old often do not understand that advertisements are designed to persuade them. In addition, many advertisements for children promote sugary snacks. Therefore, the government must take action.
options: Add more statistics about how many sugary snacks children eat, so that the evidence becomes stronger.
Remove the first sentence, because the last sentence already states the writer's opinion clearly.

After the evidence, explain why it matters — for example, that children who cannot recognise persuasion are easily influenced and are therefore likely to want unhealthy products — before reaching the conclusion.
Replace 'Therefore' with 'However' to make the link between the evidence and the conclusion more logical.
option_explanations: 段落的问题不是证据不够，而是证据没有被解释；再加数据也只是堆砌。
第一句是主题句，删掉会让段落失去中心。
正确。该段只有“论据+结论”，缺少分析：没有说明“儿童识别不了广告意图”和“广告推销零食”为什么让限制变得必要。补上分析，Therefore 才能成立。
However 表转折，用在这里会让逻辑更混乱。
hints: 先给每句贴标签：论点、论据、论据、结论——缺了哪一类？
两条论据之后，作者直接写了 Therefore，中间少了什么？
选择那个让读者明白“这些事实为什么意味着需要限制广告”的修改。
explanation: 这段属于“论据堆砌、缺少分析”：两条论据都很相关，但作者没有解释它们之间的联系，以及为什么要因此限制广告。加入如“Because young children cannot recognise persuasion, they are easily influenced by adverts for unhealthy food, which can shape their eating habits for years.”这样的分析，结论才有说服力。

instruction: 阅读主题句和论据，写 2-3 句分析：①解释论据背后的机制；②说明这如何节省公共开支（cost-effective）；③最后回扣主题句。
content:
Topic sentence: Investing in public parks is a cost-effective way to improve public health.
Evidence: In many cities, people who live within a ten-minute walk of a park are more likely to exercise regularly.
accepted: This is because a nearby park removes many of the barriers to exercise: it is free, it requires no membership, and it can be reached without a car. When more residents walk, jog or play sport regularly, fewer of them are likely to develop conditions such as obesity and heart disease, which are expensive to treat. In other words, a relatively small investment in green space can reduce long-term medical costs for a whole community, which makes parks a cost-effective public health tool.

This suggests that easy access, rather than willpower alone, often decides whether people stay active. Since regular exercise lowers the risk of chronic illnesses, a single park can help thousands of residents stay healthy for years, whereas treating those illnesses would cost far more. Building parks is therefore a cost-effective way to improve public health, because it prevents problems before they become expensive.
criteria: 通过条件：①2-3 句英文，约 40-90 词；②解释机制：附近有公园降低锻炼门槛（免费、方便、无需开车或办会员等）→更多人规律锻炼→减少肥胖、心脏病等慢性病；③必须涉及“cost-effective”：如治疗慢性病花费高，而建公园投入相对较少、惠及很多人，从而节省医疗开支；④最后一句明确回扣主题句；⑤使用分析信号（because / This means / As a result / In other words 等）；⑥不引入与论点无关的新论据；⑦语法基本正确。若学生指出该论据只是相关性并作出恰当限定（如 likely, may），可视为加分项，但不作要求。
hints: 先想：为什么住在公园附近的人更爱锻炼？锻炼又会带来什么健康结果？
主题句的关键是“cost-effective”，你需要比较“建公园的投入”和“治疗疾病的花费”。
按“门槛降低→更多锻炼→更少疾病→更少医疗开支”的顺序写，最后一句用 In other words / therefore 回到主题句。
explanation: 这道题要求完整的推理链：论据只说明“住得近的人更爱锻炼”，分析要补上为什么（门槛低）、带来什么（慢性病减少）、为什么划算（预防比治疗便宜，投入少、长期受益），最后回扣“cost-effective way to improve public health”。只写“This shows parks are good for health”远远不够。

instruction: 作者支持学生穿校服。下面哪一句最公正地陈述了反方观点？
content: Thesis: Students should be required to wear school uniforms.
options: Only lazy students who want to show off are against school uniforms.
School uniforms are good, and nobody can reasonably disagree with that.
Some people argue that uniforms limit students' freedom to express their personality.
Some people think uniforms are bad, which is a completely stupid idea.
option_explanations: 稻草人谬误：把反方贬低为“懒惰、爱炫耀”，不公正，也没有说服力。
完全否认存在合理的反方，读者会觉得作者武断。
正确。用 Some people argue that… 中立地陈述了反方的真实理由（限制个性表达）。
用 stupid 攻击反方，不礼貌也不学术，而且没有说明反方的理由。
hints: 公正陈述反方意味着：不贬低、不嘲讽，说出对方的真实理由。
注意哪些选项使用了带攻击性或绝对化的词语。
选择那个持反方观点的人读了也会点头认同的句子。
explanation: 陈述反方观点要公正：说出对方最真实、最有力的理由，用中性措辞（Some people argue that…）。贬低对方（lazy, stupid）或否认存在分歧都会削弱你的可信度，因为反驳一个被歪曲的观点毫无说服力。

instruction: 作者支持推广电动汽车。在让步句之后，哪一句是最好的反驳？
content: Admittedly, many electric cars are still more expensive to buy than similar petrol cars. ________
options: However, because they cost much less to charge and maintain, they can be cheaper than petrol cars over the lifetime of the vehicle.
Therefore, electric cars will remain too expensive for most ordinary families for many years.
Moreover, electric cars are much quieter than petrol cars, which makes city streets more pleasant.
But this is not true at all, because electric cars are the future of transport.
option_explanations: 正确。承认购车价高后，用 However 引出理由（充电和维护便宜→总成本可能更低），直接回应“贵”这一反方观点。
顺着反方继续说，等于站到了反方一边，与作者立场矛盾。
Moreover 表递进，引出的是另一个优点（安静），没有回应价格问题。
否认刚刚让步承认的事实，自相矛盾；“electric cars are the future”也只是口号，不是理由。
hints: 让步承认的是“买车贵”——反驳必须针对这一点。
反驳需要转折信号（however 等）+ 具体理由。
想一想：除了买车时的价格，车主还要花哪些钱？
explanation: 让步后的反驳要直接回应被让步的那一点，而不是换话题或自相矛盾。“However, because they cost much less to charge and maintain, they can be cheaper than petrol cars over the lifetime of the vehicle.”既承认了买价高，又用总成本的理由维护了立场。

instruction: 作者的立场是“网购对本地社区弊大于利”。哪一句正确地表达了“让步+反驳”的关系（意思和语法都正确）？
content: Writer's position: Online shopping does more harm than good to local communities.
options: Although online shopping is convenient, but it harms small local shops that depend on customers visiting in person.
Although online shopping is convenient, it harms small local shops that depend on customers visiting in person.
Online shopping is convenient. Although it harms small local shops that depend on customers visiting in person.
Despite online shopping is convenient, it harms small local shops that depend on customers visiting in person.
option_explanations: 受汉语“虽然……但是……”影响，although 和 but 不能同时使用。
正确。Although 引导让步从句（承认网购方便），主句提出反驳（伤害本地小店），语法和逻辑都正确。
“Although it harms small local shops that depend on customers visiting in person.”是不完整的从句（句子片段），不能独立成句；而且把作者的主要观点放进了让步从句，逻辑也颠倒了。
despite 是介词，后面不能直接接完整的句子；应改为 Although online shopping is convenient, … 或 Despite the convenience of online shopping, …。
hints: 四个选项的内容完全相同，区别只在于让步结构的语法和标点。
回忆 although、but、despite 各自的词性和用法。
一个让步句只需要一个连接词；despite 后面要接名词或动名词。
explanation: 让步+反驳的常用结构：Although + 从句（让步），主句（反驳）。中文“虽然……但是……”成对出现，英语里 although 和 but 只能用一个。despite / in spite of 是介词，后接名词或动名词（Despite its convenience, …）。

instruction: 作者的立场是“大学生应该承担部分学费”。下面是文中处理反方观点的段落，它最主要的问题是什么？
content: Some people believe that university education should be completely free, because this would give all young people an equal chance. It is true that high fees can discourage students from low-income families from applying. In addition, free education would allow students to focus on their studies instead of working part-time.
options: The opposing view is presented unfairly, because the writer makes it sound weaker than it really is.
There is no concession at all, so the writer seems unwilling to accept any of the other side's points.
The paragraph uses too many examples, so the main point gets lost among the details.
The writer never rebuts the opposing view and even adds more support for it, so the paragraph ends up arguing for the other side.
option_explanations: 反方观点陈述得很公正，给出了真实理由（机会平等），并没有被故意削弱。
It is true that… 就是让步，段落中有让步。
段落几乎没有具体例子，这不是问题所在。
正确。段落陈述反方、让步，然后用 In addition 继续为反方补充理由，却没有 However 引出的反驳，结果反而在支持对立观点。
hints: 检查反方段落的三个部件：反方观点、让步、反驳——哪个缺了？
注意最后一句的 In addition：它在给谁的观点加理由？
想一想读完这段后，读者会觉得作者站在哪一边。
explanation: 完整的反方段落 = 反方观点 + 让步 + 反驳。这段缺少反驳，而且 In addition 继续为反方加分，导致段落与作者立场相反。应在让步后加入反驳，例如：“However, if universities are completely free, the cost falls on all taxpayers, including those who never benefit from higher education; low fees combined with grants for poorer students would protect equal access more fairly.”

instruction: 根据给出的立场和反方观点，写 2-3 句：先公正陈述并让步，再用理由反驳。
content:
Your position: Governments should spend more on public transport than on building new roads.
Opposing view: Building new roads reduces traffic congestion.
accepted: It is true that a new road can reduce congestion in the short term. However, experience in many cities shows that extra lanes soon attract more drivers, so traffic jams return within a few years. Investing in buses and trains, by contrast, allows far more people to travel in the same amount of space.

Some people argue that building more roads is the quickest way to ease traffic jams, and this may be true at first. However, wider roads encourage more people to drive, so they soon become just as crowded as before, whereas a good metro system can carry thousands of passengers an hour without adding a single car to the streets.
criteria: 通过条件：①2-3 句英文；②公正地陈述或承认反方观点（如 It is true that… / Some people argue that…），不贬低对方；③有明确的让步信号和转折反驳信号（如 Admittedly / While… ; However / But）；④反驳必须给出理由或证据，例如：新道路会吸引更多车辆（诱发需求），拥堵很快复现；或公共交通在相同空间内能运送更多人；⑤结论与作者立场一致，不能让步过度；⑥不得出现 Although… but… 等结构错误；⑦语法基本正确。
hints: 第一步：用中立的句式承认“修路能缓解拥堵”在某种程度上是对的。
第二步：用 However 引出反驳，给出“为什么修路的效果不持久”或“公共交通更有效”的理由。
想一想：一条新路修好以后，会不会有更多人选择开车？
explanation: 好的“让步+反驳”先承认对方观点的合理部分（短期内确实能缓解拥堵），再用理由指出其局限（新路吸引更多车流，拥堵复现），最后回到自己的立场（公共交通更有效地利用道路空间）。只写“I don't agree”没有说服力。

instruction: 作者认为应该禁止化妆品动物实验。针对下面的反方观点，哪一个反驳最有效？
content: Opposing view: Animal testing is necessary to make sure that cosmetic products are safe for humans.
options: However, people who test products on animals are cruel, and no one should buy anything from their companies.
However, animals feel pain just as humans do, so it is wrong to make them suffer for the sake of beauty products.

However, many companies now use alternatives, such as tests on lab-grown human skin, and the European Union has banned the sale of cosmetics tested on animals since 2013, yet safe cosmetics are still widely available there.
However, safety does not really matter for cosmetics, because they are only put on the skin and are not medicines.
option_explanations: 人身攻击：批评做实验的人和公司，而不是回应“安全需要”这一论点。
提出的是另一个（伦理）理由，对整体立场有意义，但没有回应反方的核心——“没有动物实验就无法保证安全”。
正确。直接回应“安全”问题：已有替代方法，而且欧盟禁售后化妆品依然安全，证明动物实验并非“必要”。
否认安全的重要性，既不合理，也会让读者站到反方一边。
hints: 找出反方观点的核心词：动物实验为什么是“necessary”的？
有效的反驳要正面回应这个核心，而不是攻击人或换一个理由。
问自己：如果没有动物实验也能保证安全，反方的论点还成立吗？
explanation: 最有效的反驳会正面击中反方的核心前提（“没有动物实验就无法保证安全”），并给出证据。替代测试方法以及欧盟自 2013 年起禁售动物实验化妆品的事实说明，动物实验并不是保证安全的必要条件。人身攻击、转换理由或否认安全的重要性都无法真正回应对方。

instruction: 作者的立场是“快时尚弊大于利”。下面哪一个让步句让步过度，反而推翻了作者自己的立场？
content: Thesis: Fast fashion does more harm than good.
options: Admittedly, the benefits of fast fashion clearly outweigh all of its environmental and social costs.
Admittedly, fast fashion allows people on low incomes to buy new clothes.
It is true that the fast-fashion industry provides jobs for many workers in developing countries.
It is true that fast fashion lets young people experiment with different styles at a low cost.
option_explanations: 正确。承认“好处明显超过所有代价”等于直接承认了与论点相反的结论，后面无论怎样反驳都会自相矛盾。
合理的让步：承认一个具体好处（低收入者买得起新衣），之后仍可论证总体弊大于利。
合理的让步：承认提供就业这一事实，之后可以反驳（如工资低、工作条件差）。
合理的让步：承认一个具体好处（年轻人可以低成本尝试不同风格），没有推翻作者的整体立场。
hints: 让步应该承认“某一点”合理，而不是承认“整体结论”。
比较各选项让步的范围：是一个具体好处，还是整个利弊对比？
找出那个与论点“does more harm than good”直接相反的句子。
explanation: 让步要“有限度”：承认反方的某个具体优点，以显示公正，但不能承认反方的整体结论。“the benefits of fast fashion clearly outweigh all of its environmental and social costs”正好是论点的反面，让步之后再反驳就会自相矛盾。

instruction: 为下面的论点写一个完整的反方段落（约 90-150 词）：公正陈述最有力的反方观点→让步→有理有据地反驳（含推理或例子）→最后一句回到自己的立场。
content: Thesis: Working from home should become the normal arrangement for office workers.
accepted: Critics argue that working from home weakens teamwork, because colleagues who rarely meet in person find it harder to share ideas and solve problems together. Admittedly, some tasks, such as brainstorming a new product, do benefit from face-to-face discussion. However, this problem can be solved without bringing everyone back to the office every day. Many companies now ask staff to meet in person once or twice a month for planning sessions, while daily tasks are completed at home with the help of video calls and shared online documents. In this way, firms keep the benefits of collaboration, and employees still save hours of commuting each week. The need for teamwork is therefore a reason to organise remote work carefully, not a reason to reject it.

One common objection is that new employees learn much less when they work from home, since they cannot watch experienced colleagues or ask quick questions at the next desk. It is true that young staff may feel lost if they are simply given a laptop and left alone. However, this is a problem of poor management rather than of remote work itself. Companies can pair each newcomer with a mentor, hold short daily video meetings, and invite new staff to the office during their first few weeks. When such support is in place, junior employees can learn effectively while enjoying the flexibility that remote work offers. Therefore, the challenge of training new staff does not outweigh the clear benefits of making home working the norm.
criteria: 通过条件：①英文一段，约 90-150 词；②陈述一个有分量的真实反方观点（如影响团队合作、新员工难以学习、孤独感、工作与生活界限模糊等），并给出反方的理由，措辞中立，不贬低；③有明确的让步（Admittedly / It is true that / While…），承认反方的合理部分；④有明确的反驳（However 等），并给出具体推理、例子或可行措施，说明为何反方观点不足以否定论点；⑤最后一句回到作者立场；⑥段落内部逻辑连贯，不得自相矛盾或让步过度；⑦语法基本正确（不得出现 Although… but… 等结构错误）。
hints: 先选一个反方最有力的理由——支持坐班的人最担心什么？
结构：Critics argue that…（反方+理由）→ Admittedly…（承认合理部分）→ However…（反驳+具体措施或例子）→ Therefore…（回到立场）。
反驳时可以说明：反方指出的问题可以通过某种安排解决，因此不足以否定居家办公。
explanation: 高分反方段落的关键是“先公正、后有力”：选择对方最有分量的理由（如团队合作、新人培训），坦率承认其合理之处，再说明这个问题可以通过具体措施解决，或其影响小于好处，最后回到自己的立场。让步过度或只有一句“I disagree”都会削弱论证。

instruction: 阅读下面的论证，选出最能揭示其漏洞的关键问题。
content: My grandfather smoked every day and lived to 95, so smoking is not really dangerous.
options: Did the grandfather ever try to give up smoking?
What brand of cigarettes did the grandfather usually smoke?
Did the grandfather enjoy smoking with his friends?
Is one person's experience representative of what happens to most smokers?
option_explanations: 他是否尝试过戒烟，都改变不了“一个人能否代表所有吸烟者”这个根本漏洞。
香烟品牌是无关细节，与论证的逻辑无关。
他喜不喜欢和朋友一起抽烟，与吸烟是否危险无关。
正确。论证用一个人的例子推出关于吸烟的普遍结论，关键漏洞在于代表性。
hints: 这个论证用了多少个例子来得出结论？
关键问题之一：这个例子能代表整体吗？
选出那个质疑“一个人的情况能否推出普遍结论”的问题。
explanation: 从一个个例（爷爷活到 95 岁）推出普遍结论（吸烟不危险）是典型的以偏概全。批判性问题“这个例子有代表性吗？”立刻暴露了漏洞：大量研究表明，吸烟者整体上更容易患病和早逝。

instruction: 阅读下面的论证，哪一个问题最有助于检查其因果推理？
content: Since the new shopping mall opened last year, crime in the area has increased. Therefore, the mall has caused more crime.
options: How many floors and shops does the new shopping mall have?
Could something else that happened at the same time, such as rising unemployment, explain the increase in crime?
Do local residents enjoy shopping at the new mall at weekends?
Which company designed and built the shopping mall?
option_explanations: 商场的楼层和店铺数量与“是否导致犯罪”无关。
正确。两件事先后发生不等于存在因果关系；同一时期的其他因素（如失业率上升）也可能导致犯罪增加。
居民喜不喜欢在商场购物，与犯罪率变化的原因无关。
设计和建造商场的公司是谁，与因果推理无关。
hints: 论证的依据是：商场开业“之后”犯罪增加了。
先后发生不等于因果关系——还要排除其他解释。
选出那个提出“另一个可能原因”的问题。
explanation: “A 发生在 B 之前，所以 A 导致 B”是常见的因果谬误（post hoc）。要检验因果关系，必须问：同一时期还有没有其他因素可能导致这个变化？

instruction: 下面的论证可能存在“反向因果”（即其实是 B 导致 A）。哪一个问题指出了这种可能？
content: People who exercise regularly say that they are happier than people who do not. This proves that exercise makes people happy.
options: Did the researchers ask enough people to reach a reliable conclusion?
Could a third factor, such as having more free time, lead to both more exercise and greater happiness?
Could people who are already happy simply have more energy and motivation to exercise?
Is running better than swimming for improving people's mood?
option_explanations: 这是关于样本量的合理问题，但它不是反向因果。
这是“第三因素”（混杂变量）问题，同样有价值，但题目要求的是反向因果。
正确。它提出了相反方向的可能：不是锻炼让人快乐，而是快乐的人更有精力去锻炼。
比较运动种类，与论证的因果方向无关。
hints: 论证说：锻炼（A）→ 快乐（B）。
反向因果是指把箭头反过来：B → A。
找出那个以“快乐”作为原因、“锻炼”作为结果的问题。
explanation: 相关不等于因果，而且因果方向也可能相反。批判性提问时要分清几类问题：样本是否足够（代表性）、有没有第三因素（混杂变量）、是否反向因果。本题中，“已经快乐的人更有动力锻炼”就是反向因果的解释。

instruction: 下面的论证用了类比。哪一个问题最能检验这个类比是否成立？
content: Singapore successfully reduced traffic by charging drivers to enter the city centre. Therefore, our small town, which has no public transport, should introduce the same charge.
options: Is a small town without public transport really comparable to Singapore, where drivers have good alternatives to their cars?
In which year did Singapore first introduce its charge, and how much does it cost today?
Do people in Singapore enjoy driving more than people in other countries?
How many tourists visit Singapore each year, and where do most of them come from?
option_explanations: 正确。新加坡收费有效，部分原因是司机有完善的公共交通可选；没有公交的小镇条件完全不同，类比可能不成立。
时间和价格细节不影响两地在关键方面是否可比。
与论证逻辑无关。
游客数量和来源与这项政策能否在小镇奏效无关。
hints: 类比论证的前提是：两种情况在关键方面相似。
想一想：新加坡的收费政策之所以有效，需要什么条件？
注意论证中提到的小镇的一个特点——它和新加坡有何不同？
explanation: 类比论证要问：两者在“关键方面”真的相似吗？拥堵收费能奏效，往往是因为司机可以改乘公共交通。没有公交的小镇缺乏这一条件，照搬政策可能只会给居民带来负担。

instruction: 针对下面的论证，用英文写出两个不同的批判性问题，并在每个问题后用一句话说明它为什么重要。
content: A survey on a popular fitness app found that 90 percent of its users exercise at least four times a week. This proves that most people in our country are very active.
accepted: 1. Are the users of a fitness app representative of the whole population? People who download such an app are probably more interested in exercise than average, so the result may exaggerate how active the country is. 2. Did the users report their own activity, and could they have overstated it? If the data are self-reported, people may claim to exercise more than they really do.

1. Who uses this app, and do they reflect people of all ages, incomes and regions? If most users are young city residents who already like sport, the survey says little about the country as a whole. 2. What counts as 'exercise' in the survey? If a short walk is included, the figure may not mean that people are 'very active'.
criteria: 通过条件：①写出两个英文问题，各附一句英文解释；②两个问题必须针对不同的漏洞；③至少一个问题涉及样本代表性/自我选择偏差（健身 App 用户本来就更爱运动，不能代表全国）；④另一个问题可涉及：数据是否为自我报告、是否被夸大；“exercise”的定义；样本规模或调查方式；“proves”过于绝对等；⑤解释要说明该问题如何削弱结论；⑥问题须为正确的疑问句形式，语法基本正确。
hints: 先想一想：什么样的人会使用健身 App？
关键问题清单：样本有代表性吗？数据可靠吗？定义清楚吗？结论是否过度？
选两个不同的角度，并说明每个问题如何削弱“most people in our country”这一结论。
explanation: 这个论证最大的漏洞是自我选择偏差：健身 App 的用户本来就爱运动，不能代表全国人口。此外，数据若是自我报告可能被夸大，“exercise”的定义也可能很宽松。写批判性问题时，要指出漏洞并说明它为什么让结论站不住脚。

instruction: 阅读下面的论证，哪一个问题揭示了其推理中最严重的漏洞？
content: Cities with many cycle lanes, such as Amsterdam and Copenhagen, have some of the happiest residents in the world. Therefore, if our city builds more cycle lanes, our residents will become happier too.
options: Do residents of Amsterdam and Copenhagen still use their cycle lanes in the cold winter months?
Would building more cycle lanes in our city be expensive, and who would pay for them?
Which of the two cities has more kilometres of cycle lanes per resident?
Could other factors that these cities share, such as high incomes and strong social services, explain why their residents are happy?
option_explanations: 细节问题，无论答案如何都无法动摇“自行车道→幸福”这一因果推断的根本缺陷。
成本是政策层面的合理考虑，但不涉及论证的逻辑：即使很便宜，自行车道也未必能带来幸福。
比较两城的细节，与论证是否成立无关。
正确。这两座城市在收入、社会福利等方面都有优势，这些因素可能才是居民幸福的主要原因（第三因素/其他解释），因此不能推出修自行车道就能让人更幸福。
hints: 论证从“这些城市自行车道多而且居民幸福”推出了一个因果结论。
最严重的漏洞通常在因果推断本身，而不是细节或成本。
问问自己：阿姆斯特丹和哥本哈根除了自行车道之外，还有哪些共同点？
explanation: 这个论证把相关当成了因果：自行车道多的城市居民幸福，但这些城市同时也富裕、福利完善，这些第三因素可能才是幸福的真正原因。成本和细节问题有一定意义，但不触及推理中最核心的漏洞。

instruction: 有人对下面的论证提出了批判性问题：“Could something else explain the rise in scores?” 哪一个修改版本最好地回应了这个问题？
content: Original argument: Since our school started a meditation class, students' test scores have risen. Meditation clearly improves academic results.
options: Since our school started a meditation class, students' test scores have risen dramatically, so meditation definitely improves academic results.
Meditation is an ancient practice that has been used for thousands of years, so it must have real benefits for students.

Since our school started a meditation class, test scores have risen, which suggests that meditation may help; however, the school also hired several new maths teachers that year, so a fair comparison with a similar school is needed.
Every school in the world should introduce meditation classes immediately, because our results prove that they work.
option_explanations: 只是加强语气（dramatically, definitely），完全没有回应“其他解释”的问题，反而更武断。
诉诸传统：历史悠久不能证明它能提高成绩，而且完全回避了“其他解释”的问题。
正确。承认了其他可能原因（新老师），用 suggests / may 限定结论，并提出了获得更可靠证据的方法（与相似学校比较）。
从一所学校跳到全世界，过度概括，也没有回应“其他解释”的问题。
hints: 这个批判性问题针对的是“其他可能的原因”。
好的修改要么排除其他原因，要么承认它们并限定结论。
好的修改不会加强语气或扩大结论，而是会正面承认可能存在的其他原因。
explanation: 面对“有没有其他解释”的质疑，正确的回应是：承认其他可能因素、用限定词降低结论强度，并说明需要什么证据来区分不同原因。加强语气、转移话题或扩大结论都只会让论证更弱。

instruction: 阅读下面的论证，写一段约 70-120 词的英文评论：用批判性问题指出至少两个不同的漏洞，并说明需要什么样的证据才能让论证更有力。
content: Video games make teenagers violent. A study found that teenagers who had been arrested for violent crimes played video games more often than average. Moreover, after a popular shooting game was released last year, the number of fights reported at our school went up. Therefore, the government should ban violent video games.
accepted: This argument has several weaknesses. First, the study only shows a correlation: teenagers who commit violent crimes may play more video games, but this does not prove that the games caused their behaviour. It is equally possible that aggressive teenagers are attracted to violent games, or that a third factor, such as a difficult family situation, explains both. Second, the rise in fights at one school after one game was released could easily be a coincidence. To be convincing, the writer would need long-term studies comparing similar groups of teenagers who do and do not play violent games.

The argument raises several critical questions. Are teenagers who have been arrested representative of all teenagers? Probably not, so their gaming habits tell us little about the effect of games on ordinary young people. Did anything else change at the school last year, such as class sizes or the head teacher? Without ruling out such factors, the increase in fights cannot be blamed on one game. Finally, even if games had some effect, a complete ban would go far beyond what the evidence shows. Controlled studies that follow teenagers over several years would provide much stronger support.
criteria: 通过条件：①英文一段，约 70-120 词，语气正式客观；②指出至少两个不同的漏洞，可选：相关≠因果；反向因果（有暴力倾向的青少年更喜欢暴力游戏）；第三因素（家庭环境、社会环境等）；样本问题（被捕青少年不能代表全体青少年）；一所学校、一次事件可能是巧合/先后≠因果；从“可能有影响”跳到“全面禁止”的结论跳跃；③每个漏洞要有简短解释，而不是只列术语；④至少提出一种能加强论证的证据（如长期追踪研究、对比相似青少年群体、控制其他变量的研究等）；⑤语法基本正确，逻辑清楚。
hints: 分别检查两条论据：研究对象是谁？学校的事件能说明什么？
用关键问题清单：样本有代表性吗？是因果还是相关？会不会是反向因果或第三因素？结论是否跳跃？
每指出一个漏洞，都用一句话说明“为什么这会削弱结论”，最后提出一种更可靠的研究方式。
explanation: 这个论证至少有四个漏洞：①相关≠因果；②可能是反向因果（有暴力倾向的青少年更爱玩暴力游戏）或存在第三因素（家庭环境）；③被捕青少年和一所学校都不具代表性，一次事件可能只是巧合；④从“可能有影响”跳到“全面禁止”。好的评论要指出漏洞、解释原因，并提出更可靠的证据，如长期对比研究。

instruction: 你是考官。阅读题目和学生段落，选出最影响得分的问题。
content:
Task: Should children learn to cook at school? Give your opinion.

Student's paragraph: Restaurants are becoming more and more popular in China. At weekends, many families go out to eat because it is convenient and they can try different dishes. Some restaurants are very expensive, while others are quite cheap. In big cities, people can also order food online and receive it within thirty minutes. The restaurant industry also creates many jobs for young people. In conclusion, eating in restaurants has become an important part of modern life.
options: The paragraph contains so many grammar mistakes that the meaning is often unclear.
The paragraph does not address the task: it describes restaurants instead of discussing whether children should learn to cook at school.
The paragraph uses too few linking words, so the ideas are not connected to each other.
The paragraph is too short to be assessed, because a body paragraph needs at least ten sentences.
option_explanations: 段落语法基本正确，意思清楚，语法不是主要问题。
正确。题目问“孩子是否应在学校学做饭”，段落却在描述餐馆行业，完全没有回应题目，任务回应（Task Response）严重失分。
段落有 while、also、In conclusion 等连接词，句子之间也连得上，衔接不是主要问题。
段落长度适中，可以评分；“至少十句”也不是任何评分标准的要求。
hints: 先重读题目：它到底在问什么？
考官的第一个问题：这段文字回答了题目吗？
看一看段落里有没有出现 children、school 或 cook 这些与题目相关的内容。
explanation: 跑题是最严重的问题，语言再好也无法弥补。这段讲的是餐馆行业的现状，与“孩子是否应在学校学做饭”无关，考官会在任务回应上给很低的分数。

instruction: 你是考官。阅读题目和学生段落，选出最影响得分的问题。
content:
Task: Is it better to live in a big city or a small town?

Student's paragraph: I believe that living in a big city is better than living in a small town. Big cities are better places to live. There are many advantages of living in big cities, and these advantages are very important. That is why more and more people want to live in big cities. In my opinion, big cities are the best choice for everyone, and everyone should move to a big city if possible.
options: The writer's opinion is not clear, because the paragraph never says which place is better.
Almost every sentence contains a serious grammar error, which makes the paragraph hard to understand.
The idea is repeated but never developed: the writer does not say what the advantages are or give any examples.
The paragraph is off-topic, because it does not answer the question of which place is better to live in.
option_explanations: 立场非常清楚（I believe that living in a big city is better），这不是问题。
句子语法基本正确，意思也很好懂，问题不在语法。
正确。同一个观点被重复了五次，却从未说明有哪些优点、为什么，更没有例子，论证完全没有展开。
段落讨论的正是“大城市还是小镇更好”，并明确回答了这个问题，没有跑题。
hints: 立场清楚吗？是否切题？——如果都是，再往下看。
数一数段落里有几个具体的理由或例子。
注意“many advantages”——作者有没有告诉读者是哪些优点？
explanation: 这段立场清楚、切题，但内容空洞：只是反复声明观点，没有任何具体理由（如工作机会、医疗和教育资源）或例子。考官会认为观点“未展开”（not developed），任务回应分数受限。

instruction: 你是考官。阅读题目和学生段落，选出最影响得分的问题。
content:
Task: Has technology improved the way students learn?

Student's paragraph: Technology has changed the way students learn. Moreover, many students now use tablets instead of printed textbooks. On the contrary, they can find information online in seconds. Furthermore, some students become distracted by games and social media. In addition, teachers need to make sure that technology is used wisely. Therefore, technology has both advantages and disadvantages.
options: Several linking words are used incorrectly — for example, 'On the contrary' introduces a similar idea and 'Furthermore' introduces a disadvantage — which makes the logic hard to follow.
The paragraph has no topic sentence, so the reader cannot tell what it is about.
The vocabulary is too simple to receive a good score, because there are very few advanced words.
The paragraph is off-topic, because it discusses teachers while the task only asks about students.
option_explanations: 正确。连接词被机械堆砌且用错：第一个例子前的 Moreover 没有可递进的内容；On the contrary 后面并非相反观点；Furthermore 引出的却是缺点（应用 However）。这严重影响连贯与衔接（Coherence and Cohesion）。
第一句“Technology has changed the way students learn.”就是主题句，点明了本段话题。
词汇虽不华丽，但准确恰当；用词简单不是最主要的问题。
提到老师如何引导学生使用技术，仍与学生的学习有关，并未跑题。
hints: 这段的观点和词汇都还可以——留意每句开头的那个词。
每个连接词都表达一种逻辑关系：递进、转折、对比、结果。检查它们是否与前后句真的匹配。
特别看看 On the contrary 和 Furthermore 前后两句话是什么关系。
explanation: 中国学生常以为“连接词越多越好”，但用错连接词会误导读者。本段 Moreover / On the contrary / Furthermore 都与实际逻辑不符，例如引出缺点时应该用 However。考官会在连贯与衔接上扣分，并认为连接词使用“机械”（mechanical）。

instruction: 你是考官。题目要求“讨论双方观点并给出你的看法”。下面是学生的开头段，哪一项评价最准确？
content:
Task: Some people believe that unpaid community service should be compulsory for high school students. Others think it should be voluntary. Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

Student's introduction: Nowadays, with the development of society, more and more people have begun to pay attention to the problem of community service. It is a hot topic. Different people have different opinions. In this essay, I will discuss this problem.
options: Lexical Resource is the main weakness, because the writer uses too many rare and difficult words.
Grammatical accuracy is the main weakness, because most of the sentences contain basic errors.
Task Response is the main weakness: the introduction relies on memorised general phrases, does not present the two views, and gives no clear position.
Coherence and Cohesion is the main weakness, because the sentences are not connected by any linking words.
option_explanations: 开头段用词反而非常简单笼统，并没有使用生僻难词。
这几句话语法基本正确，问题不在语法。
正确。全是万能模板句（with the development of society, hot topic, different people have different opinions），没有说明“必修/自愿”两种观点，也没有表明立场，任务回应失分最多。
开头段有 Nowadays、In this essay 等衔接手段；即使再加连接词，也解决不了没有回应题目的问题。
hints: 先对照题目要求：开头段应该交代什么？
一个好的开头要改写题目、点明两种观点，并说明自己的立场。
把这段开头放到任何话题的作文里，它是不是也能用？
explanation: 这是典型的“模板开头”：放到任何题目下都适用，说明它没有真正回应题目。好的开头应改写题目、点明两种观点并亮出立场，例如：“While some argue that high school students should be required to do unpaid community work, others believe it should remain a personal choice. In my view, a short compulsory programme is beneficial, provided that students can choose the type of service.”

instruction: 你是考官。阅读题目和学生段落，选出最准确的评价。
content:
Task: Should governments invest more in public transport?

Student's paragraph: Investing in public transport is one of the most effective ways to reduce traffic congestion. A single bus can carry as many passengers as dozens of cars, so when more people choose buses or trains, fewer vehicles compete for space on the roads. For example, after London introduced a congestion charge and used part of the money to improve bus services, traffic in the city centre fell noticeably. This shows that public transport works best when it is combined with measures that make driving less attractive. Such investment therefore benefit both commuters and the environment.
options: The paragraph is off-topic, because it discusses a congestion charge rather than investment in public transport.
The paragraph has no supporting evidence, so its main claim is only the writer's personal opinion.
The biggest problem is that the paragraph uses too many linking words, which makes it sound mechanical.
The argument is clear, explained and supported with an example; its main weakness is a minor subject-verb agreement error ('investment … benefit'), which would only slightly affect the grammar score.
option_explanations: 拥堵费的收入被用来改善公交服务，例子与公共交通投资直接相关，没有跑题。
段落有推理（一辆巴士≈几十辆车）和伦敦的具体例子，支撑充分。
连接词（so, For example, This shows, therefore）数量适中且使用正确。
正确。这是一个结构完整（观点—解释—例子—分析—结论）的好段落，唯一明显的问题是 investment benefit 应为 benefits，属于小错误，对分数影响有限。
hints: 先按优先级检查：切题吗？有论证吗？逻辑清楚吗？
如果大问题都没有，再看是否只剩下小的语言错误。
大问题都排除后，逐句检查语言细节，尤其是最后一句。
explanation: 当考官也要能识别“好段落”。这段切题、有解释、有具体例子、有分析，结构完整；唯一的问题是最后一句主谓不一致（应为 Such investment therefore benefits…）。考官不会因为一个小错误而大幅扣分——要学会区分主要问题和次要问题。

instruction: 你是考官。下面是学生的整篇作文（已缩写）。选出最影响得分的问题。
content:
Task: Why are more children becoming overweight, and what can be done about it?

Student's essay (shortened): Childhood obesity is a serious problem in many countries. The main cause is diet: children eat more fast food and sugary drinks than in the past, partly because these products are cheap and heavily advertised. Another cause is a lack of exercise, as many children spend their free time on screens instead of playing outside. Busy parents also have less time to cook healthy meals. In conclusion, unhealthy food, screen time and busy parents are the main reasons why children are becoming overweight.
options: The response ignores the second part of the task — it never suggests any solutions — so its Task Response score would be seriously limited.
The causes are listed but not explained at all, so the reader does not know why they lead to obesity.
The vocabulary is too informal for an academic essay, which would seriously lower the Lexical Resource score.
The conclusion should have introduced a new cause to make the essay more interesting and complete.
option_explanations: 正确。题目有两问：原因和解决办法。文章只讨论了原因，完全没有提出解决办法，漏答一半题目，任务回应严重受限。
每个原因都有简要解释（如便宜且广告多、空闲时间花在屏幕上），这不是主要问题。
用词总体恰当，没有明显的口语化问题。
结论不应引入新观点，这个说法本身就是错误的写作建议。
hints: 数一数题目中有几个问题。
考官首先检查是否回答了题目的“每一部分”。
找一找文章中有没有 should、can be done、solution 这类表示解决办法的内容。
explanation: 在“原因+解决办法”的双问题题型中，漏答其中一问是最严重的任务回应问题之一。这篇作文对原因分析得不错，但完全没有回答“what can be done about it”，无论语言多好，任务回应分都会被严重限制。

instruction: 你是考官。阅读学生引言中的立场句和第一个主体段，选出最影响得分的问题。
content:
Task: Some people believe that zoos should be closed. To what extent do you agree?

Introduction (last sentence): I completely agree that all zoos should be closed.

First body paragraph: Zoos play an important role in protecting endangered species. Many animals, such as the giant panda, have been bred successfully in captivity, which has helped to increase their numbers. Zoos also give children the chance to see wild animals up close, which can inspire them to care about nature. Therefore, zoos make a valuable contribution to society.
options: The body paragraph has no examples, so its points about zoos are not supported at all.
The body paragraph argues the opposite of the introduction and never rebuts these points, so the writer's position is contradictory — a serious Task Response problem.
The grammar in the body paragraph is too simple, because it uses only short, basic sentences.
The giant panda example has nothing to do with zoos, because pandas are wild animals that live in forests.
option_explanations: 段落有大熊猫等具体例子，并不缺例子。
正确。引言说“完全同意关闭所有动物园”，主体段却论证动物园很有价值，而且没有任何反驳，立场前后矛盾，考官无法判断作者的观点。
段落使用了 which 引导的从句等复合句，语法准确，不是主要问题。
大熊猫的圈养繁殖正是动物园保护物种的例子，与话题相关。
hints: 先找出作者在引言中的立场。
再看主体段的最后一句结论，它支持的是哪一方？
如果这段想作为反方段落，它缺少了什么？
explanation: 立场必须贯穿全文。这个主体段本身写得不错，但它的结论（zoos make a valuable contribution）与引言立场正好相反，且没有 However 引出的反驳。若想写反方观点，必须在让步后反驳，例如指出保护工作可以在野生动物保护区完成。否则考官会认为立场不清或自相矛盾。

instruction: 你是考官。阅读题目和学生段落，选出最准确的评价。
content:
Task: Do the benefits of social media outweigh its drawbacks?

Student's paragraph: In this epoch of digitalisation, social media has indubitably become an indispensable constituent of our quotidian existence. Its multifarious ramifications are manifest in every stratum of society. Admittedly, it possesses both merits and demerits, which are of paramount significance. Consequently, it is incontrovertible that the drawbacks of social media outweigh its benefits, and authorities ought to take efficacious measures.
options: The paragraph would score highly for Lexical Resource, because it uses a wide range of advanced, less common vocabulary.
The main problem is that the sentences are too long and complex for the reader to follow.
The paragraph is off-topic, because it never mentions social media or its effects.

Behind the impressive-sounding words, the paragraph names no specific benefit or drawback and gives no reasons or examples, so its conclusion is unsupported; the forced, unnatural word choice also harms rather than helps the vocabulary score.
option_explanations: 考官看重的是用词准确、自然、得体，而不是生僻词的数量；这些词堆砌生硬（如 constituent of our quotidian existence），反而会被扣分。
句子长度不是主要问题（其实每句都不算太长），问题在于内容空洞、用词不自然。
段落多次明确提到 social media，并给出了（尽管毫无依据的）结论，没有跑题。
正确。整段没有说出任何一个具体的好处或坏处，“Consequently… incontrovertible”的结论毫无依据；生僻词堆砌也让表达不自然，词汇分不升反降。
hints: 试着把这段话用简单英语复述一遍：作者到底说了什么具体内容？
评分标准对词汇的要求是“准确、自然”，对任务回应的要求是观点有展开和支撑。
找一找：段落中有没有提到任何一个具体的好处、坏处或例子？
explanation: 这是“华丽空壳”式段落：大量背诵来的生僻词（indubitably, quotidian, multifarious），却没有任何具体观点、理由或例子，Consequently 引出的结论也无从推出。考官会在任务回应上给低分，而生硬、不自然的用词在词汇项上同样会扣分。用简单准确的语言说清具体内容，远比堆砌难词得分高。

instruction: 下面哪一句最适合用于学术议论文？（语气严谨、不过度绝对化，也不口语化）
content: Topic: Do violent video games affect children's behaviour?
options: Video games always make children violent.
Violent video games can make some children more aggressive.
Every child who plays video games becomes violent and lazy.
Maybe video games are bad for kids.
option_explanations: always 是绝对化表达，很多玩游戏的孩子并不暴力，一个反例就能推翻这句话。
正确。can 表示可能性，some children 缩小了范围，观点清楚但不夸大。
every child 和 becomes 都是绝对化断言，还额外加入 lazy，属于过度概括。
Maybe 开头以及 kids、bad 都偏口语，不符合学术语域；而且观点模糊。
hints: 找出每个选项中表示“程度”或“范围”的词，如 always, every, maybe。
学术写作既要避免绝对化（always / every），也要避免口语化的 maybe 和 kids。
正确答案同时用了一个表示可能性的情态动词和一个缩小范围的数量词。
explanation: 限定语气（hedging）用 can / may / tend to / some 等词让论断与证据相符。Violent video games can make some children more aggressive. 用 can 表示可能性、用 some children 缩小范围，既有观点又不夸大。always / every 一个反例就能推翻；maybe、kids 属于口语表达。

instruction: 选择最合适的词填空，使句子语气严谨。
content: Students who study abroad ______ become more independent than those who stay at home.
options: always
definitely
tend to
must
option_explanations: always 过度绝对：并非所有留学生都会更独立。
definitely 表示“肯定”，同样是没有证据支持的绝对断言。
正确。tend to 表示“往往、倾向于”，说明这是普遍趋势而非绝对规律。
must 表示义务或非常肯定的推断，语义过强，读起来像“必须变得更独立”。
hints: 空格处的词决定了这句话有多“绝对”。
描述普遍趋势时，学术写作会选用一个承认存在例外的表达，而不是 always / definitely。
排除表示“百分之百确定”和表示“义务”的词。
explanation: tend to + 动词原形 是最常用的限定表达之一，表示“通常、往往”。Students who study abroad tend to become more independent than those who stay at home. 承认存在例外，比 always / definitely / must 更符合学术写作的严谨要求。

instruction: 下面句子中的 proves 语气过强。选出替换 proves 最恰当的词语。
content: The fall in crime after the cameras were installed proves that surveillance makes cities safer.
options: guarantees
confirms beyond doubt
means
suggests
option_explanations: guarantees（保证）比 proves 更绝对，完全不符合要求。
beyond doubt（毫无疑问）仍是绝对化表达，与原句的问题相同。
means 把犯罪下降直接等同于监控有效，依然没有承认存在其他可能原因。
正确。犯罪率下降只是与安装摄像头“同时发生”，也可能有其他原因（如警力增加），用 suggests（表明、暗示）更符合证据强度。
hints: 想一想：犯罪率下降一定是摄像头造成的吗？
相关不等于因果；证据有限时，报告动词的语气应明显弱于 prove。
排除所有表示“确定无疑”或“二者等同”的选项。
explanation: 报告动词也有强弱：prove / demonstrate 最强，show 次之，suggest / indicate 较弱。单一数据（安装摄像头后犯罪下降）只能说明二者相关，不能证明因果，因此应写 The fall in crime after the cameras were installed suggests that surveillance makes cities safer.（还可进一步把 makes 改为 may make）。

instruction: 限定语气要适度。下面哪一句既不过度绝对、也不过度含糊？
content: Topic: Does working from home improve productivity?
options: Remote work can improve productivity, particularly for tasks that require deep concentration.
It is possible that remote work might perhaps improve productivity to some extent in certain cases.
Remote work definitely improves productivity for all employees.
Remote work improves productivity, and no one can deny this.
option_explanations: 正确。一个 can 表示可能性，particularly for ... 说明适用范围，观点明确又严谨。
过度限定：It is possible / might / perhaps / to some extent / in certain cases 叠加五个限定，读者看不出作者到底怎么想。
definitely 和 all employees 都是绝对化表达。
no one can deny 是夸张的断言，实际上很多人对此有不同看法。
hints: 数一数每个选项中有几个限定词（may, might, perhaps, to some extent...）。
限定手段一般一两个就够；叠加太多会让观点消失，完全不用又会显得武断。
找出只用了一个情态动词、同时说明了适用范围的句子。
explanation: Hedging 不是越多越好。过度限定（might perhaps ... to some extent in certain cases）会让论点失去力度；绝对化（definitely, no one can deny）则容易被反驳。最佳做法是一个限定词 + 明确范围：Remote work can improve productivity, particularly for tasks that require deep concentration.

instruction: 用恰当的限定语气改写下面的句子，使其符合学术写作要求。保留原句的两个意思（孤独、效率低），至少使用一种限定手段，不要用 maybe。
content: Working from home makes everyone lonely and unproductive.
accepted: Working from home can make some employees feel lonely and less productive.
Working from home tends to leave many employees feeling isolated, which may reduce their productivity.
For many people, working from home may lead to loneliness and lower productivity.
criteria: 通过条件：1）必须去掉或替换绝对化的 everyone（如 some / many employees, many people, for many people）；2）至少使用一种恰当的限定手段（can / may / might / tend to / often / many / some 等）；3）保留“孤独”和“效率下降”两层意思；4）不使用口语化的 maybe，不叠加三个或更多限定词导致观点模糊；5）语法正确、语域正式。把 unproductive 改为 less productive 等更准确的表达是加分项，不是必需项。
hints: 先找出句中让论断变得绝对的那个词。
可以缩小范围（some / many），也可以用情态动词或 tend to 降低确定性。
把“所有人”换成一部分人，并考虑在动词前加一个表示可能性的词。
explanation: everyone 让这句话只要举出一个反例就会被推翻（很多人在家办公既开心又高效）。改写时既可缩小范围（some / many employees），也可降低确定性（can / may / tend to），两者结合也很常见；同时 unproductive 太绝对，less productive 更准确。示例：Working from home can make some employees feel lonely and less productive.

instruction: 阅读下面的段落，哪一句最需要加限定语气？
content: (1) Many cities have introduced bike-sharing schemes in the past decade. (2) These schemes give residents a cheap alternative to driving short distances. (3) As a result, they have completely solved the problem of traffic congestion in urban areas. (4) Some cities are now expanding their networks to suburban districts.
options: Sentence (1)
Sentence (2)
Sentence (3)
Sentence (4)
option_explanations: (1) 用 Many cities 已经限定了范围，是可以核实的事实。
(2) 描述的是共享单车的基本功能，属于合理的一般性陈述，不算过度断言。
正确。completely solved（彻底解决）是夸大的因果断言：交通拥堵有很多原因，共享单车最多只能缓解。可改为 they have helped to reduce traffic congestion in some urban areas.
(4) 用 Some cities 限定，描述的是事实，不需要再加限定。
hints: 找一找哪一句做出了最强的因果判断。
注意表示“彻底、完全”的副词，并思考一个措施能否解决复杂的社会问题。
问问自己：哪一句只要举出一个仍然拥堵的城市就能被推翻？
explanation: 限定语气最需要用在“结论 / 因果”句上。(3) 中 completely solved 声称一个措施彻底解决了城市拥堵，任何仍然拥堵的城市都是反例。更严谨的写法：As a result, they have helped to reduce traffic congestion in some urban areas. 而 (1)(4) 已用 many / some 限定，(2) 是合理的一般陈述。

instruction: 限定语气要与证据强度相符。下面哪一句属于“不必要的过度限定”，即把一个已被充分证实的事实说得太弱？
options: Smoking may possibly be linked to lung cancer in some cases.
A four-day working week may improve employee well-being in some industries.
